abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) remains one of the most widely used risk measures in finance due to its simplicity, interpretability, and regulatory prominence, particularly within the Basel framework. However, VaR is not a coherent risk measure, as it generally fails to satisfy the subadditivity property. This paper demonstrates that, although finite weighted combinations of VaR-type functionals do not necessarily yield coherent risk measures, appropriately constructed infinite weighted averages of quantiles can generate coherent risk measures. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a two-parameter weight function that jointly depends on the quantile level and a position parameter, and propose a novel coherent risk measurement framework termed generalized quantile regression (GQR). In particular, we establish explicit and verifiable conditions on the weight function under which the resulting risk functional satisfies coherence, reversibility, monotonicity, and comparability across quantile levels. The proposed framework is flexible, interpretable, and unifying: it encompasses a broad class of existing coherent risk measures as special cases while also generating several new and economically meaningful risk measures. These results provide a characterization that is not explicitly available in conventional distortion or spectral risk measure frameworks. We further develop corresponding nonparametric estimators, including in multi-dimensional settings, and investigate their asymptotic properties. Empirical studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GQR framework in both risk assessment and portfolio optimization.
abstract_zh: 风险价值（VaR）因其简洁性、可解释性及在监管框架（尤其是巴塞尔协议）中的突出地位，至今仍是金融领域应用最广泛的风险度量之一。然而，VaR并非一致性风险度量，因为它通常不满足次可加性。本文证明，尽管有限加权组合的VaR型泛函未必能产生一致性风险度量，但适当构造的分位数无限加权平均却能生成一致性风险度量。受此观察启发，我们引入一个同时依赖于分位数水平和位置参数的双参数权重函数，并提出一种新颖的一致性风险度量框架，称为广义分位数回归（GQR）。特别地，我们建立了关于权重函数的显式且可验证的条件，在这些条件下，所得风险泛函满足一致性、可逆性、单调性以及跨分位数水平的可比性。该框架灵活、可解释且具有统一性：它将现有广泛类别的一致性风险度量作为特例涵盖其中，同时也能生成若干新的且具有经济意义的风险度量。这些结果提供了一种在传统扭曲或谱风险度量框架中并未明确给出的刻画。我们进一步开发了相应的非参数估计量，包括多维情形下的估计量，并研究了其渐近性质。实证研究证明了所提出的GQR框架在风险评估和投资组合优化中的有效性。
title: A family of coherent risk measures: an infinite weighted average of Value-at-Risk

abstract: Matrix-valued time-series data have become increasingly prevalent across diverse fields, including economics, finance, computer science, engineering, and signal processing. However, mixed matrix-vector structures in real-world data present challenges for existing methods. To fill in this gap, we propose a multi-matrix autoregressive (MMAR) model designed to jointly model matrix time series with varying structures. The key idea is to treat matrices as elements and to model their contemporaneous and intertemporal relationships within a simultaneous equation system. In particular, the matrix-valued autoregressive model and the three-order tensor autoregressive model are special cases of the proposed model. We present three distinct estimation methods for the MMAR model, investigate their statistical properties, and provide numerical simulations to corroborate them. Furthermore, we integrate the MMAR model with connectedness network analysis, proposing a multi-modal connectedness framework to estimate the interconnectedness between the rows and columns of matrices. Finally, we provide an empirical application to concurrently model the macroeconomic matrix time series of China’s 31 provinces and a vector time series comprising the economic policy uncertainty, trade policy uncertainty, and geopolitical risk. The findings of the empirical study provide valuable insights for further research and policymaking in the relevant domains.
abstract_zh: 矩阵值时间序列数据在经济学、金融学、计算机科学、工程学及信号处理等多个领域日益普遍。然而，现实世界数据中混合矩阵-向量结构对现有方法提出了挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种多矩阵自回归（MMAR）模型，旨在联合建模具有不同结构的矩阵时间序列。其核心思想是将矩阵视为元素，并在联立方程系统中建模其同期及跨期关系。特别地，矩阵值自回归模型和三阶张量自回归模型是所提模型的特例。我们为MMAR模型提出了三种不同的估计方法，研究了它们的统计性质，并通过数值模拟加以验证。此外，我们将MMAR模型与连通性网络分析相结合，提出了一种多模态连通性框架，用于估计矩阵行与列之间的相互关联性。最后，我们提供了一个实证应用，同时建模中国31个省份的宏观经济矩阵时间序列以及包含经济政策不确定性、贸易政策不确定性和地缘政治风险的向量时间序列。实证研究结果为相关领域的进一步研究和政策制定提供了有价值的见解。

abstract: This paper develops a data-driven inference procedure for extreme analysis of data with near epoch dependence (NED), a condition less restrictive than traditional dependence structures like α-mixing, making it particularly useful for analyzing heavy-tailed time series data. To capture nonlinear data structures, we propose a new framework that combines local linear quantile regression with extreme value theory. We first study the asymptotic properties of the local-linear intermediate conditional quantile (IQR) estimators under NED by establishing the Bahadur representation. While we show the IQR estimator exhibits the desired asymptotic normality for NED data, it is unstable and inaccurate for estimation at extreme quantile levels. Therefore, we develop an enhanced Hill method to estimate the nonlinear extreme value index (EVI) and, consequently, the extreme conditional quantiles (ECQ) based on the tail properties and extrapolation. We show that the proposed EVI and ECQ estimators have the same asymptotic bias. We further develop a bias correction approach to refine these estimators. We thoroughly study the properties of the proposed EVI and ECQ estimators under NED, and their bias-corrected counterparts. Simulation studies and real data analyses demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed methods.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种数据驱动的推断程序，用于分析具有近邻依赖（NED）数据的极端值，这一条件比传统依赖结构如α-混合更为宽松，特别适用于分析重尾时间序列数据。为捕捉非线性数据结构，我们提出了一种结合局部线性分位数回归与极值理论的新框架。我们首先通过建立Bahadur表示，研究了在NED条件下局部线性中间条件分位数（IQR）估计量的渐近性质。虽然我们证明了IQR估计量在NED数据下展现出理想的渐近正态性，但在极端分位数水平下其估计不稳定且不准确。因此，我们开发了一种增强的Hill方法来估计非线性极值指数（EVI），并进而基于尾部性质和 extrapolation 估计极端条件分位数（ECQ）。我们证明了所提出的EVI和ECQ估计量具有相同的渐近偏差。我们进一步开发了一种偏差校正方法来优化这些估计量。我们深入研究了在NED条件下所提出的EVI和ECQ估计量及其偏差校正版本的性质。模拟研究和实际数据分析证明了所提出方法的有效性和适用性。
title: Extremal Local Linear Quantile Regression for Heavy-Tailed Time Series with near Epoch Dependence

abstract: Credit card use among college students declined sharply following the enactment of the Credit Card Accountability, Responsibility, and Disclosure Act of 2009. Title 3, Section 304 of the Act specifically restricted the marketing and sale of credit cards on college campuses. Using a difference-in-differences approach that treats incoming freshmen who would have been unaffected by this marketing as the control group, we document an apparent spillover that increased student loan borrowing by 8.4%, and by 14% for less affluent students. A survey of students matched to their administrative records finds evidence of this substitutability between credit cards and student loans; further, it reveals that a lack of financial literacy and knowledge of financial history are correlated with the misallocation of debt between them. Using these combined empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a model of optimal student borrowing to assess the benefits of the spillovers and find the policy increased welfare. A complementary analysis indicates improvements in grade point averages and on-time graduation rates subsequent to the Act. This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339 .
abstract_zh: 在2009年《信用卡问责、责任与信息披露法案》实施后，大学生信用卡使用量显著下降。该法案第三章第304条特别限制了信用卡在校园内的营销和销售。采用双重差分方法，将不受此营销影响的新生作为对照组，我们记录到一种明显的溢出效应，即学生贷款借款增加了8.4%，对于经济条件较差的学生则增加了14%。一项将学生调查与其行政记录相匹配的研究发现了信用卡与学生贷款之间这种替代性的证据；此外，该研究还揭示，金融知识匮乏和对财务历史了解不足与两者间债务错配相关。结合这些实证发现，我们开发并校准了一个最优学生借款模型，以评估这些溢出效应的益处，并发现该政策增进了福利。一项补充分析表明，该法案实施后，平均绩点和按时毕业率有所提高。本文由John Beshears在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339获取。

abstract: Randomized experiments have become the standard method for companies to evaluate the performance of new products or services. Beyond aiding managerial decision making, experiments mitigate risk by limiting the proportion of customers exposed to innovations. Because many experiments are conducted sequentially over time, an emerging strategy to further derisk the process is to allow managers to “peek” at the results as new data become available and stop the test if the results are statistically significant. The class of statistical methods that allow managers to peek and still provide valid inference are often called anytime valid because they maintain proper uniform type 1 error guarantees. In this paper, we extend existing anytime-valid approaches to accommodate the more complex yet standard settings in time series, switchback, and panel experiments. To achieve this, we leverage the design-based approach to focus on assumption-light and managerially relevant finite-sample estimands defined on the study participants as a direct measure of the risks incurred by companies. As a special case, our (asymptotic) results also provide a robust method for achieving always-valid inference in A/B tests. We further provide a variance reduction technique incorporating modeling assumptions and covariates. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach through a simulation study and three real-world applications from Netflix. Our results show that using our confidence sequence, harmful experiments could be stopped after observing only a handful of units; for instance, our method would have stopped a 30,000-person Netflix experiment after the first 100 people. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235 .
abstract_zh: 随机化实验已成为企业评估新产品或服务性能的标准方法。除了辅助管理决策外，实验通过限制暴露于创新中的客户比例来降低风险。由于许多实验随时间顺序进行，一种进一步降低过程风险的新兴策略是允许管理者在新数据可用时“窥视”结果，并在结果统计显著时停止测试。允许管理者窥视且仍能提供有效推断的统计方法类别通常被称为随时有效，因为它们保持了适当的均匀第一类错误保证。在本文中，我们将现有的随时有效方法扩展到更复杂但标准的场景，包括时间序列、切换和面板实验。为实现这一目标，我们利用基于设计的方法，聚焦于定义在研究参与者上的轻假设且与管理相关的有限样本估计量，作为公司所承担风险的直接度量。作为特例，我们的（渐近）结果也为A/B测试中实现始终有效推断提供了一种稳健方法。我们进一步提供了一种结合建模假设和协变量的方差缩减技术。最后，我们通过模拟研究和来自Netflix的三个实际应用证明了所提方法的有效性。我们的结果表明，使用我们的置信序列，有害实验可以在仅观察少量单元后停止；例如，我们的方法本可以在前100人后停止一个30,000人的Netflix实验。本文被J. George Shanthikumar接受，数据科学领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235获取。

abstract: We document that interactions with manipulated clinical decision support (CDS) systems can induce not only short-term, but also long-term changes in physicians’ opioid prescribing behavior. Physicians in our sample adopted electronic health record software from a list of federally certified vendors in 2011. Between 2016 and Spring 2019, one vendor secretly embedded a biased CDS function designed to promote extended-release opioid sales. Affected physicians not only increased opioid claims relative to the control group during the treatment window, but also maintained a higher propensity to prescribe opioids, even after the biased function was removed. This long-term behavioral change persisted even after affected physicians moved to new locations, changed their affiliations, or faced stricter state-level opioid regulations. Increasing physician awareness helped mitigate this impact. Using machine-learning algorithms, we estimate that decision-making distortion accounts for approximately 54% of the treatment effects in a physician decision model with dynamic learning. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930 .
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，与受操纵的临床决策支持（CDS）系统的交互不仅会引发医生阿片类药物处方行为的短期变化，还会导致长期改变。在我们的样本中，医生于2011年从联邦认证供应商名单中采用了电子健康记录软件。在2016年至2019年春季期间，一家供应商秘密嵌入了一个旨在促进缓释阿片类药物销售的偏倚CDS功能。受影响的医生不仅在治疗窗口期内相对于对照组增加了阿片类药物索赔，而且在偏倚功能被移除后，仍保持较高的阿片类药物处方倾向。这种长期行为变化甚至在受影响的医生迁往新地点、更换隶属关系或面临更严格的州级阿片类药物监管后依然持续。提高医生的认知有助于缓解这一影响。利用机器学习算法，我们估计在具有动态学习的医生决策模型中，决策扭曲约占治疗效应的54%。本文被信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930获取。

abstract: We study the impact of inventory constraints on bundling in a dynamic pricing setting, challenging the classical view that bundling consistently enhances revenue. Traditional bundling theory, which typically assumes abundant inventory and static pricing, often asserts that bundling generates higher revenue than selling products individually. However, we show that limited inventory, in fact, distorts the revenue-extraction capability of bundling, favoring the sale of products or services separately. We study the optimal dynamic mixed bundling strategy in a large market regime where the market size grows relative to limited inventory. Leveraging this framework, we derive optimal dynamic pricing policies and value functions for commonly used bundling strategies, including mixed bundling, pure bundling, bundle size pricing, and component pricing. Our analysis reveals that as inventory becomes more constrained relative to market size, the optimal dynamic mixed bundling strategy converges to a dynamic component pricing strategy, outperforming both dynamic bundle size pricing and dynamic pure bundling. Moreover, the performance gap between these strategies increases with the number of items, a factor typically viewed as favoring bundling when inventory is abundant. Notably, our numerical experiments reveal that these structural insights extend to policies derived from the standard fluid regime. As the market size grows relative to the inventory, the dynamic mixed bundling policy obtained by resolving the deterministic fluid problem also reduces to a dynamic component pricing policy. This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120 .
abstract_zh: 我们研究了动态定价环境中库存约束对捆绑销售的影响，挑战了捆绑销售总能提升收入的传统观点。传统捆绑理论通常假设库存充裕且定价静态，常主张捆绑销售比单独销售产品能带来更高收入。然而，我们表明，有限的库存实际上扭曲了捆绑销售的收益提取能力，反而有利于产品或服务的单独销售。我们研究了市场规模相对于有限库存增长的大市场机制下的最优动态混合捆绑策略。利用这一框架，我们推导了常用捆绑策略的最优动态定价策略和价值函数，包括混合捆绑、纯捆绑、捆绑规模定价和组件定价。我们的分析揭示，随着库存相对于市场规模变得更加受限，最优动态混合捆绑策略收敛于动态组件定价策略，其表现优于动态捆绑规模定价和动态纯捆绑。此外，这些策略之间的绩效差距随项目数量增加而扩大，而这一因素在库存充裕时通常被视为有利于捆绑销售。值得注意的是，我们的数值实验表明，这些结构性见解也适用于从标准流体机制推导出的策略。随着市场规模相对于库存增长，通过求解确定性流体问题获得的动态混合捆绑策略同样简化为动态组件定价策略。本文由Karan Girotra接受发表于运营管理领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120获取。

title: The Diminishing Value of Bundling Under Inventory Scarcity

abstract: We study randomized experiments in a service system when stochastic congestion can arise from temporarily limited supply or excess demand. Such congestion gives rise to cross-unit interference between the waiting customers, and analytic strategies that do not account for this interference may be biased. In current practice, one of the most widely used ways to address stochastic congestion is to use switchback experiments that turn a target intervention on and off for the whole system in alternation. We find, however, that under a queueing model for stochastic congestion, the standard way of analyzing switchbacks is inefficient and that estimators that leverage the queueing model can be materially more accurate. Additionally, we show how the queueing model enables estimation of total policy gradients from unit-level randomized experiments, thus giving practitioners an alternative experimental approach they can use without needing to precommit to a fixed switchback length before data collection. abstract_zh: 我们研究在服务系统中，当随机拥塞可能源于暂时性供应不足或需求过剩时进行的随机实验。这种拥塞导致等待顾客之间存在跨单元干扰，而未考虑此干扰的分析策略可能产生偏差。当前实践中，应对随机拥塞最广泛使用的方法之一是切换实验，即对整个系统交替开启和关闭目标干预措施。然而，我们发现，在随机拥塞的排队模型下，标准的切换分析方式效率较低，而利用排队模型的估计器能显著提高准确性。此外，我们展示了排队模型如何从单元级随机实验中估计总政策梯度，从而为实践者提供一种替代实验方法，无需在数据收集前预先设定固定的切换长度。本文被Vivek Farias接受，数据科学领域。资助：本研究由ONR [Grant N000142412091]支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306 获取。

abstract: Despite widespread optimism among regulators and market practitioners about corporate asset-backed securitization (ABS), its relationship with firm performance remains unclear. This study examines the association between corporate ABS and firm performance in China using a novel look-through approach to identify actual originators of ABS transactions. We document an inverted U-shaped relationship between corporate ABS scale and firm performance. Firm performance is positively associated with ABS issuance at low-to-moderate levels, but this association turns negative when issuance becomes excessive. Heterogeneity analyses show that this nonlinear relationship varies across ownership types and firm sizes and is more pronounced among non-state-owned and larger firms. Multiple analyses suggest that corporate ABS issuance in China functions less as pure risk transfer and more as debt-like financing, and the leverage-channel analysis further provides corroborative evidence that leverage helps explain the inverted U-shaped relationship between ABS issuance and firm performance. These findings advance our understanding of the relationship between corporate ABS and firm performance in China and offer practical implications for firms and regulators.
abstract_zh: 尽管监管机构和市场从业者普遍对企业资产支持证券化（ABS）持乐观态度，但其与企业绩效之间的关系仍不明确。本研究采用一种新颖的透视方法识别ABS交易的实际发起人，考察了中国企业ABS与企业绩效之间的关联。我们发现，企业ABS规模与企业绩效之间存在倒U型关系。在低至中等发行水平下，企业绩效与ABS发行正相关，但当发行过度时，这种关联转为负向。异质性分析显示，这种非线性关系因所有权类型和企业规模的不同而有所差异，且在非国有企业和大型企业中更为显著。多项分析表明，中国企业ABS发行更多扮演的是类似债务融资的角色，而非纯粹的风险转移，杠杆渠道分析进一步提供了佐证证据，表明杠杆有助于解释ABS发行与企业绩效之间的倒U型关系。这些发现加深了我们对中国企业ABS与企业绩效关系的理解，并为企业和监管机构提供了实践启示。

abstract: Using novel survey data from 1426 firms in Guatemala, Honduras, and El Salvador, we examine the voluntary adoption of accounting systems by microenterprises operating in the informal economy and its association with access to credit and business growth. Despite the absence of regulatory mandates, 44 percent of informal microbusinesses maintain systematic financial records, with roughly three-quarters of those using notebooks and one-quarter using digital records. Accounting quality is closely linked to the owner’s startup motivation, financial stake, and management capabilities. Informal firms that rely on larger suppliers, extend customer installment credit, engage in marketing promotions, or employ more formal organizational structures are also more likely to adopt structured recordkeeping systems, highlighting accounting’s role as a managerial tool rather than as a compliance function or as a precursor to entering the formal economy. Informal firms that maintain notebooks separating business and personal accounts are significantly more likely to apply for and obtain bank loans. Our inferences for access to credit also extend to microenterprises in the Dominican Republic. In addition, accounting quality appears to support lender due diligence even among informal firms, particularly when lenders are more sophisticated. Using a broader measure of credit market status, we find that accounting quality rises monotonically across credit tiers. Finally, we find that entrepreneurs with higher-quality accounting systems are more likely to plan for business expansion. By illuminating the motivations behind accounting choices in low-enforcement settings, this study deepens our understanding of the foundational role accounting plays in early-stage business development in emerging markets.

abstract: We examine the effects of legalizing fentanyl test strips (FTS), which identify the presence of fentanyl in recreational drugs, on overdose deaths. Using difference-in-differences methods, we find that purely increasing de jure access to fentanyl test strips (FTS), which can reduce information asymmetries regarding drug contents, had little effect on overdose mortality. We then examine the effects of multi-dimensional community-based interventions aimed at increasing de facto access to FTS and other harm reduction resources. These hands-on approaches were more effective in reducing overdose deaths. Together, these findings suggest that FTS are used at sub-optimal levels, and more active efforts to distribute them could reduce overdoses.

abstract: The German universal long-term care (LTC) insurance program offers beneficiaries the choice between in-kind services and a cash benefit, which can be used for anything, including informal care. The optimal level of the cash benefit depends on substitution between formal and informal care options, the cost of public funds, and distributional considerations. To evaluate various policy options, we estimate a random-coefficients demand model for the period 1999-2015 using data on the universe of LTC patients supplemented with micro moments from the German Mikrozensus. Results show strong heterogeneity in patient preferences for the three different LTC options: informal, ambulatory and stationary care. A counterfactual analysis predicts that abolishing the cash subsidy leads to a decline in patient surplus that far outweighs the savings in public expenditure. It suggests that many countries could benefit from the introduction of a cash subsidy option for LTC.

abstract: This paper examines whether the changes in long-term care (LTC) preferences, saving behavior, and policy attitudes observed during the COVID-19 pandemic have persisted in the post-pandemic period. Using new survey data collected in 2023 from a representative sample of working-age individuals in Ontario and Qu´ebec, we compare responses to those obtained during the first phase of the pandemic in 2020. We document that nursing-home aversion remains widespread several years after the crisis and continues to shape economic behavior and policy preferences. Individuals who are more averse to nursing homes are significantly more likely to plan to increase saving for old age and to support public subsidies for home care. These relationships are robust across demographic and socioeconomic groups, indicating that the effects are not confined to specific subpopulations. Overall, our findings suggest that the pandemic has led to persistent changes in preferences with important implications for LTC financing and policy design. In particular, the continued mismatch between household preferences and the current emphasis on institutional care highlights the need to reassess the allocation of public resources toward home-based care.

abstract: Patient cost-sharing in health insurance tends to reduce moral hazard, but the effect may differ between subgroups. For instance, one may expect low-income groups to react more strongly to cost-sharing than high incomes. With the help of a structural microsimulation model, we estimate the response to changes in cost-sharing across gender, age and income groups. We estimate the parameters of our model using Dutch individual-level healthcare data for the years 2011 to 2019. We find an overall average elasticity of approximately -0.11, with considerable variation in elasticities across age groups but only minimal variation across income quintiles or between genders. An increase in cost-sharing causes the largest increase in out-of-pocket expenditure for the elderly. Further, our calculations indicate that the rate of decrease in health care demand as a result of an increase in out-of-pocket payments is similar across all income quintiles. Consequently, our model does not support the notion that the current Dutch deductible represents a disproportionately large financial burden for low income groups.

abstract: This paper examines household avoidance behavior in response to drinking water contamination under the Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA). A major challenge in studying behavioral responses to public notifications is that the timing recorded in the Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) often does not accurately reflect when contamination information becomes publicly available. To address this issue, this study combines SDWIS violation records with detailed water testing data from the EPA’s Six-Year Review (SYR) to infer more accurate notification timing for Tier 1 drinking water violations. The analysis links public water system service areas to weekly store-level bottled-water sales data and estimates dynamic responses using a staggered event-study design. Preliminary results show a sharp increase in bottled-water sales immediately following contamination notifications. When notification timing is measured using the SYR generation date, bottled-water sales increase by approximately 40 percent in the week after notification, substantially larger than estimates based on EPA enforcement dates. The findings suggest that inaccurate administrative timing may substantially attenuate estimated behavioral responses in prior studies and highlight the importance of precise notification timing when evaluating environmental information disclosure policies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了《安全饮用水法》（SDWA）下家庭对饮用水污染信息的规避行为。研究公众通知行为反应的一大挑战在于，《安全饮用水信息系统》（SDWIS）中记录的时间往往不能准确反映污染信息向公众公开的实际时点。为解决这一问题，本研究将SDWIS违规记录与美国环保署（EPA）六年审查（SYR）中的详细水质检测数据相结合，以推断一级饮用水违规通知的更准确时间。分析将公共供水系统服务区域与周度商店层面的瓶装水销售数据相链接，并采用交错事件研究设计估计动态反应。初步结果显示，污染通知发布后瓶装水销售立即出现显著增长。当使用SYR生成日期衡量通知时间时，通知后一周内瓶装水销售增长约40%，显著大于基于EPA执法日期估计的结果。研究结果表明，行政记录时间的不准确可能大幅低估以往研究中估计的行为反应，并凸显了在评估环境信息披露政策时精确通知时间的重要性。
title: Household Responses to Drinking Water Contamination: Evidence from Public Notification, Bottled Water Consumption, and Infant Health
title_zh: 家庭对饮用水污染的反应：来自公共通知、瓶装水消费与婴儿健康的证据

abstract: Glyphosate, the active ingredient of the herbicide RoundUp, has been subject to extensive scrutiny since the introduction of genetically engineered glyphosate tolerant crops in 1995. However, both a lack of observational studies and continued uncertainty around the toxicity of glyphosate emissions contribute to international political controversy and numerous civil actions at a time when US rural health measures are worsening and youth cancer rates are rising. Recent quasi-experimental studies using genetically engineered crop adoption as a source of exposure variation found glyphosate applications caused deleterious infant health effects in rural US areas, but we are unsure their exposure is truly exogenous. We reassess glyphosate’s effects on infant health using two sources of exposure variation in two-stage least squares instrumental variable approaches for twelve different infant health measures. We first similarly employ genetically engineered crop adoption but using seed sale marketing data, which is a more accurate measure of adoption relative to previous attempts. We then use changes in glyphosate product characteristics from the introduction of generic product types using product sales marking data, which is a novel separate source of variation. We do not find any consistent significant health changes from glyphosate exposure, where estimates are generally precise, pass typical assumption tests, and are robust to alternative specifications. By investigating the association between genetically engineered crop adoption and several rural co-occurring health and agricultural trends, we obtain evidence exposure variation from genetically engineered crop adoption is probably not independent from other agricultural production externalities. While this study provides evidence glyphosate did not contribute to rural health problems from 1995 to 2013, we believe pesticide data limitations, continued glyphosate controversy, and remaining potential for toxic agricultural emissions justifies evaluations of improved environmental monitoring.
abstract_zh: 草甘膦，作为除草剂RoundUp的活性成分，自1995年转基因耐草甘膦作物引入以来，一直受到广泛关注。然而，观察性研究的缺乏以及草甘膦排放毒性方面的持续不确定性，在美国农村健康指标恶化、青少年癌症发病率上升之际，引发了国际政治争议和大量民事诉讼。近期利用转基因作物采用作为暴露变异来源的准实验研究发现，草甘膦施用对美国农村地区婴儿健康产生了不良影响，但我们不确定其暴露是否真正外生。我们重新评估草甘膦对婴儿健康的影响，采用两种暴露变异来源，通过两阶段最小二乘工具变量方法，针对十二项不同的婴儿健康指标进行分析。首先，我们同样利用转基因作物的采用情况，但使用种子销售市场数据，这比以往尝试更能准确衡量采用程度。其次，我们利用产品市场销售数据，通过引入非专利产品类型导致的草甘膦产品特性变化，这是一个新颖且独立的变异来源。我们未发现草甘膦暴露导致任何一致且显著的健康变化，估计结果普遍精确，通过常规假设检验，并对不同规格设定具有稳健性。通过探究转基因作物采用与农村地区同时发生的健康及农业趋势之间的关联，我们获得证据表明，转基因作物采用带来的暴露变异可能并非独立于其他农业生产外部性。尽管本研究提供了1995年至2013年间草甘膦未导致农村健康问题的证据，但我们认为，农药数据局限性、持续的草甘膦争议以及有毒农业排放的潜在风险，都要求对改进环境监测进行评估。

title: Perhaps Still the Lesser Evil? The Trouble Investigating Glyphosate Health Effects in the US
title_zh: 或许仍是较轻之恶？美国草甘膦健康效应调查之困境

abstract: Over the past four decades, the U.S. healthcare system has shifted from hospital-based care toward outpatient and community-based services, fundamentally changing where and how frontline care is delivered. Using establishment-level data from the Longitudinal Business Database and American Community Survey (1980–2023), we examine trends across eight healthcare industries. While most frontline services expanded, physician offices declined sharply, particularly in rural areas, alongside a broader shift toward larger, multi-establishment firms. Rural healthcare is not simply declining but being reconfigured into a different mix of services, with greater reliance on outsourced care, especially for capital-intensive diagnostics. Employment-based access remains lower in non-metro counties across several frontline services. Provider presence is closely tied to payer mix, though these relationships are weaker in rural areas where structural constraints appear more binding. These patterns suggest the transition to outpatient care has redistributed access unevenly, contributing to growing geographic disparities and spatial mismatches in healthcare access.
abstract_zh: 过去四十年间，美国医疗体系已从以医院为中心的照护模式转向门诊及社区基础服务，从根本上改变了前线医疗服务提供的地点与方式。利用纵向商业数据库及美国社区调查（1980-2023年）中的机构层面数据，我们考察了八个医疗行业的趋势。尽管大多数前线服务有所扩展，但医生诊所在农村地区尤其急剧缩减，同时伴随着向更大规模、多机构企业的整体转变。农村医疗并非简单衰退，而是被重构为不同的服务组合，更加依赖外包服务，尤其是资本密集型诊断服务。在多个前线服务领域，非都市县的就业基础获取渠道仍然较低。服务提供者的存在与支付方结构密切相关，但在农村地区，这些关系较弱，结构性约束似乎更具束缚力。这些模式表明，向门诊照护的转型不均衡地重新分配了获取渠道，加剧了医疗获取方面的地理差异与空间错配。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国医疗体系，使用美国数据，不涉及中国、中国企业、人群或地区。
title: Shifts in Frontline Healthcare Services and Rural Access to Care
title_zh: 一线医疗服务转变与农村就医可及性

abstract: A substantial literature finds poor mental health is hump-shaped with respect to age, whilst subjective wellbeing is U-shaped. Recent cross-sectional studies indicate a change in this relationship driven by the declining mental health of the young. We contribute to this literature by re-examining the age patterns in subjective wellbeing and illbeing for individuals in five European countries (France, Germany, Italy, Spain and Sweden). We do so with fifteen waves of the COME-HERE (CH) panel survey for 2020-2025 plus data from the Global Minds (GM) surveys of 2020-2026 for the same countries. We show that wellbeing rises and illbeing declines in a roughly monotonic fashion with age. This is found both with cross-section data from the CH and GM data, and from longitudinal plots of person fixed effects by age in the CH data.
abstract_zh: 大量文献发现，心理健康状况随年龄呈倒U型分布，而主观幸福感则呈U型分布。近期横截面研究显示，这一关系正发生变化，其驱动因素为年轻人心理健康的下降。我们通过重新考察五个欧洲国家（法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和瑞典）个体主观幸福感与心理困扰的年龄模式，为这一文献领域做出贡献。我们利用2020-2025年十五轮COME-HERE（CH）面板调查数据，以及同一国家2020-2026年Global Minds（GM）调查数据进行分析。研究结果显示，幸福感随年龄大致呈单调上升趋势，而心理困扰则单调下降。这一结论在CH和GM数据的横截面分析中，以及CH数据中按年龄划分的个体固定效应纵向图中均得到验证。
title: Illbeing Among the Young in Europe: Evidence from the COME HERE Panel
title_zh: 欧洲年轻人的福祉困境：来自COME HERE面板数据的证据

abstract: A documented diagnosis only benefits patients who know about it. Using nationally representative Health and Retirement Study data linked to Medicare claims (1998-2020), we quantify the gap between clinically documented dementia diagnoses and patients
abstract_zh: 有记录的诊断仅对知晓该诊断的患者有益。利用与医疗保险索赔数据相关联的全国代表性健康与退休研究数据（1998-2020年），我们量化了临床记录的痴呆诊断与患者之间的差距。
title: Dementia Diagnosis Underreporting and Downstream Care Engagement and Planning Among US Older Adults
title_zh: 美国老年人痴呆症诊断漏报及其后续护理参与和规划

abstract: -Life expectancy has risen substantially across Sub-Saharan African (SSA), but national trajectories have diverged. Malawi represents a striking case of transformation, moving from one of the region’s lowest ranked countries in 1950 to among its leaders in 2023 despite persistent economic stagnation. We examine how age specific mortality changes contributed to Malawi’s exceptional gains in life expectancy and compares its mortality transition with those of other SSA countries. We use age and sex specific mortality data from the 2024 United Nations World Population Prospects for 15 SSA countries between 1950 and 2023. Countries were selected to represent the highest, average, and lowest performing groups in life expectancy at birth in 1950. We analyze trends, decompose changes using the Arriaga method, and estimate potential future gains from eliminating mortality at specific ages. Results show that Malawi recorded the largest increase in life expectancy, gaining 36.2 years for females and 33.2 years for males. Its mortality decline followed a broadly similar age pattern to the region but with exceptional intensity: between 1950 and 1980, two thirds of gains came from childhood mortality reductions, while after 2000, adult survival improvements contributed nearly half. Malawi’s resilience during the HIV/AIDS crisis and rapid post 2000 recovery highlight the combined influence of expanded female education, large scale donor investment, and community-based health programs. Our findings provide the first long term age specific decomposition of Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in comparative SSA context, highlighting the changing age structure of mortality reduction in the region.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区的预期寿命显著提升，但各国轨迹呈现分化。马拉维是一个引人注目的转型案例，尽管经济持续停滞，该国却从1950年该地区排名最低的国家之一，跃升至2023年的领先者之列。我们考察了年龄别死亡率变化如何促进马拉维预期寿命的非凡增长，并将其死亡率转型与其他撒哈拉以南非洲国家进行比较。我们使用2024年联合国《世界人口展望》中1950年至2023年间15个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的年龄和性别别死亡率数据。所选国家代表1950年出生时预期寿命的最高、平均和最低表现群体。我们分析趋势，运用Arriaga方法分解变化，并估算消除特定年龄死亡率的潜在未来收益。结果显示，马拉维的预期寿命增幅最大，女性增加36.2岁，男性增加33.2岁。其死亡率下降遵循与该地区大致相似的年龄模式，但强度异常突出：1950年至1980年间，三分之二的收益来自儿童死亡率下降，而2000年后，成人存活率改善贡献了近一半。马拉维在HIV/AIDS危机期间的韧性及2000年后的快速复苏，凸显了女性教育扩展、大规模捐助者投资和社区健康计划的综合影响。我们的研究首次在撒哈拉以南非洲比较背景下，对马拉维预期寿命转型进行了长期年龄别分解，揭示了该地区死亡率下降年龄结构的动态变化。
authors: Ben Malinga John (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock, Germany)
Jiaxin Shi (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock, Germany)
title: From laggard to leader: Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in Sub-Saharan African context, 1950–2023
title_zh: 从落后者到领跑者：撒哈拉以南非洲背景下马拉维预期寿命的转变，1950—2023年

abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了COVID-19学校关闭对加拿大有学龄儿童父母劳动力市场结果的影响。利用新收集的覆盖141个加拿大城市的分年级学校关闭数据，以及来自劳动力调查的个体层面面板数据，双重差分估计提供了稳健证据，表明面对面教学限制使有学龄儿童的已婚母亲就业率下降了约2个百分点。对于父亲而言，劳动力供给调整较弱，且主要集中在单亲父亲群体。最后，利用行政税务记录的辅助分析提供了提示性证据，表明学校关闭增加了单亲父母领取公共福利的情况。
title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
title_zh: 学校中断对父母劳动力供给的影响：来自加拿大面板数据的证据

abstract: The relative effectiveness of non-pharmaceutical interventions, such as lockdowns and work-from-home mandates, depends on whether individuals adjust their social behavior in response to infection risk when policy restrictions are absent. Exploiting geographic variation in COVID-19 exposure during the first wave, three key results emerge. First, we find evidence that areas with relatively high excess death rates during the first wave of the pandemic had relatively low excess death rates during the second wave. Second, using granular mobility data from GPS devices, we show that the same areas saw relatively high mobility during the second wave, which may suggest that the first finding is driven by an immunity effect. Finally, the heterogeneity analysis reveals that scarring, behavioral responses, and immunization may operate with varying intensity across municipalities with different age compositions, yielding observable differences in both second-wave mobility and mortality patterns.
abstract_zh: 非药物干预措施（如封锁和居家办公指令）的相对有效性，取决于在政策限制缺失时，个体是否会因感染风险而调整其社交行为。利用第一波疫情期间COVID-19暴露的地理差异，我们得出三个关键结果。首先，我们发现，在第一波疫情中超额死亡率相对较高的地区，在第二波疫情中的超额死亡率相对较低。其次，利用来自GPS设备的细粒度流动性数据，我们显示这些地区在第二波疫情中的流动性相对较高，这可能表明第一个结果是由免疫效应驱动的。最后，异质性分析揭示，疤痕效应、行为反应和免疫作用在不同年龄构成的城市中可能以不同强度运作，从而在第二波流动性和死亡率模式上产生可观察的差异。
title: Running the Risk: Immunity and Mobility in Response to a Pandemic
title_zh: 承担风险：疫情应对中的免疫与流动性

abstract: We study the extent to which exposure to COVID-19 relates to healthcare professionals' prosociality. Drawing on empirical evidence from an incentivized experiment and a companion survey of healthcare professionals (HCPs) at a large Italian hospital (N = 194), we find that different forms of exposure to COVID-19 predict their altruistic motivation in heterogeneous ways. HCPs who worked in COVID-19 wards or had a close relative or friend severely affected by the virus are more than 5 percentage points more likely to prioritize patient welfare over personal gain, with the association for professional exposure being mostly driven by female HCPs, especially nurses. Conversely, personally contracting COVID-19 is associated with a 6 percentage point decline in prosociality. Our results highlight that different experiences of need shape prosocial behavior in hospital settings
abstract_zh: 我们研究了接触COVID-19与医护人员亲社会性之间的关联程度。基于一项激励性实验及对意大利一家大型医院医护人员（N=194）的配套调查所获得的实证证据，我们发现不同形式的COVID-19接触对其利他动机的预测作用存在异质性。在COVID-19病房工作过或身边有亲属或好友因该病毒而受到严重影响的人员，其将患者福祉置于个人利益之上的可能性高出超过5个百分点，其中职业暴露的关联效应主要由女性医护人员（尤其是护士）驱动。相反，个人感染COVID-19则与亲社会性下降6个百分点相关。我们的研究结果凸显了不同的需求经历如何塑造医院环境中的亲社会行为。
title: COVID-19 Pandemic and Prosociality: An Experiment with Healthcare Professionals
title_zh: COVID-19疫情与亲社会行为：一项针对医疗保健专业人员的实验

abstract: This paper uses a structural gravity model to examine the partial equilibrium effects of the European Monetary Union (EMU) on trade for the agricultural sector. We find robust evidence that EMU has increased trade both between members and between EMU and non‐EMU member countries. This positive link is found in most member countries. Moreover, the overall impact of EMU on trade between members has not been different for late and early joiners. The year‐by‐year and period‐by‐period analyses show that the effect of EMU is increasing over time. In addition, we conduct a counterfactual general equilibrium experiment that reveals a remarkable welfare‐enhancing effect of EMU for its member countries.
abstract_zh: 本文运用结构引力模型，考察了欧洲货币联盟（EMU）对农业部门贸易的部分均衡效应。我们发现有力证据表明，EMU不仅促进了成员国之间的贸易，也增进了EMU与非成员国之间的贸易。这一正向关联在大多数成员国中均有所体现。此外，EMU对成员国间贸易的总体影响在后期加入国与早期加入国之间并无显著差异。逐年及逐期分析显示，EMU的效应随时间递增。进一步地，我们实施了一项反事实一般均衡实验，结果表明EMU为其成员国带来了显著的福利增进效应。
title: EMU and trade: The euro effect on the agricultural sector
title_zh: 欧洲经济货币联盟与贸易：欧元对农业部门的影响

abstract: Customers in over‐the‐counter (OTC) markets must find a counterparty to trade. Little is known about this process, however, because existing data consist of transaction records, which only reveal the outcome of a search. Using data from a trading platform for corporate bonds, we unpack the search process. We analyze how long it takes customers to trade and how dealers' offers evolve across repeated inquiries. We estimate that it takes two to three days to complete a transaction after an unsuccessful attempt, with substantial variation across trade and customer characteristics. Our analysis offers insights into the sources of trading delays in OTC markets.
abstract_zh: 在场外交易（OTC）市场中，客户必须寻找交易对手方。然而，由于现有数据仅包含交易记录，仅能揭示搜索的结果，因此对这一过程知之甚少。利用公司债券交易平台的数据，我们揭示了搜索过程。我们分析了客户完成交易所需的时间，以及交易商在多次询价中报价的演变情况。我们估计，在一次不成功的尝试后，完成一笔交易需要两到三天时间，且这一时长因交易和客户特征的不同而有显著差异。我们的分析为理解OTC市场交易延迟的根源提供了见解。
title: Sequential Search for Corporate Bonds
title_zh: 公司债券的序贯搜索

abstract: We study productivity disparities across metropolitan and non‐metropolitan areas in Great Britain. Spatial disparities in productivity are large and persistent. Using a development accounting framework, we show that differences in area size and in the spatial distribution of human and business capital are key explanatory factors. A combination of area size and human capital explains 30% of the productivity variance, increasing to 43–57% once we add measures of business capital stocks. Applying our framework to a case study of Greater Manchester, we show that large increases in both types of capital are needed to narrow productivity disparities with London, illustrating the scale of the challenge for policies aimed at reducing spatial inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国大都市与非大都市地区之间的生产率差异。空间上的生产率差异既大且持久。运用发展核算框架，我们表明区域规模以及人力资本和商业资本的空间分布差异是关键解释因素。区域规模与人力资本的结合解释了生产率变异的30%，而一旦加入商业资本存量指标，这一比例提升至43%至57%。将我们的框架应用于大曼彻斯特的案例研究，我们发现，要缩小与伦敦的生产率差距，需要大幅增加这两类资本，这凸显了旨在减少空间不平等的政策所面临的挑战规模。
title: Spatial productivity disparities in Great Britain
title_zh: 英国空间生产率差异研究

abstract: Regulatory tightening aims to curb opportunistic insider trading by reducing informational advantages. However, the effectiveness of such reforms, particularly in emerging markets with historically weak enforcement, remains debated. This study investigates the effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades in India, an emerging market. We focus on the implementation of the Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations 2015, which introduced stricter disclosure requirements, higher penalties, and a reversal of the burden of proof. Using a comprehensive sample of insider trades from 2008 to 2024, we employ difference-in-differences and propensity score matching to assess changes in the predictive power of insider trades for future stock returns. Our findings indicate that the regulatory reforms did not diminish the overall informativeness of insider trades. Notably, while insider purchases retained their positive predictive value, insider sales, previously uninformative, gained significant negative information content post-regulation. These results suggest that enhanced enforcement may amplify rather than suppress the market’s ability to incorporate insider information, underscoring the role of rigorous implementation in emerging markets. We recommend that regulators prioritize enforcement mechanisms to balance investor protection with market efficiency.
abstract_zh: 监管收紧旨在通过减少信息优势来遏制机会主义的内幕交易。然而，此类改革的有效性，尤其是在历史上执法薄弱的新兴市场中，仍存在争议。本研究探讨了监管收紧对印度这一新兴市场中内幕交易信息含量的影响。我们聚焦于2015年《内幕交易禁止条例》的实施，该条例引入了更严格的披露要求、更高的罚款以及举证责任的倒置。利用2008年至2024年间全面的内幕交易样本，我们采用双重差分法和倾向得分匹配来评估内幕交易对未来股票收益预测能力的变化。研究发现，监管改革并未削弱内幕交易的整体信息含量。值得注意的是，尽管内幕买入保持了其正向预测价值，而此前无信息含量的内幕卖出在监管后获得了显著的负向信息含量。这些结果表明，加强执法可能放大而非抑制市场吸收内幕信息的能力，凸显了在新兴市场中严格实施的重要性。我们建议监管机构优先考虑执法机制，以平衡投资者保护与市场效率。
title: The effect of regulatory tightening on the information content of insider trades
title_zh: 监管收紧对内部人交易信息含量的影响

abstract: From an individual agent’s perspective, a deterministic strategyproof mechanism is characterized by an option set: it selects the agent’s most-preferred alternative from that set. This paper develops a stochastic generalization of option sets. To this end, we focus on what we call single-agent mechanisms, which capture the perspective of a single agent. We show that a stochastic dominance strategyproof (sd-strategyproof) single-agent mechanism can be represented by a normalized, scaled, nondecreasing, and submodular set function defined on subsets of alternatives, and conversely. Through duality, this representation establishes a one-to-one correspondence between sd-strategyproof single-agent mechanisms and nondecreasing convex games with grand-coalition value one. We also observe that option sets, viewed as set functions, are dual to unanimity games. Consequently, every sd-strategyproof single-agent mechanism can be expressed as a linear combination of deterministic strategyproof single-agent mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 从单个代理人的视角来看，一个确定性策略proof机制的特征在于一个选项集合：它从该集合中选择代理人最偏好的备选方案。本文发展了选项集合的随机推广。为此，我们聚焦于所谓的单代理人机制，该机制捕捉了单个代理人的视角。我们证明，一个随机占优策略proof（sd-strategyproof）的单代理人机制可以由定义在备选方案子集上的一个归一化、缩放、非递减且子模的集合函数来表示，反之亦然。通过对偶性，这一表示建立了sd-strategyproof单代理人机制与具有大联盟值为一的非递减凸博弈之间的一一对应关系。我们还观察到，选项集合作为集合函数，与一致博弈是对偶的。因此，每个sd-strategyproof单代理人机制都可以表示为确定性策略proof单代理人机制的线性组合。
title: Stochastic dominance strategyproofness and submodularity
title_zh: 随机占优策略无懈可击性与次模性

abstract: We study the strong core of housing markets when agents’ preferences over houses are expressed as partial orders. We provide a structural characterization of the strong core, and propose an efficient algorithm that finds an allocation in the strong core or decides that it is empty, even in the presence of forced and forbidden arcs. The algorithm satisfies the property of weak group-strategyproofness. Additionally, we show that certain results known for the strong core in the case where agents’ preferences are weak orders can be extended to the setting with partial order preferences; among others, we show that the strong core in such housing markets satisfies the property of respecting improvements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人对房屋的偏好以偏序形式表达时住房市场的强核。我们提供了强核的结构性特征，并提出了一种高效算法，该算法能在存在强制弧和禁止弧的情况下找到强核中的分配或判定其为空。该算法满足弱群体策略证明性。此外，我们证明，在代理人偏好为弱序的情况下已知的关于强核的某些结果可以扩展到偏序偏好设置中；其中，我们证明此类住房市场中的强核满足尊重改进的性质。
title: The strong core of housing markets with partial order preferences
title_zh: 具有偏序偏好的住房市场的强核

abstract: Increasing attention is being paid to the design of economic incentives for conservation on private land to encourage spatial coordination. We investigate the effects of using incorrect information on the ecological benefits of spatial coordination in the design of a conservation auction, using a framed field experiment with real farmers as participants. We find that auction performance can be substantially weakened if the parameters adopted are ‘wrong enough’ to change which farms are prioritized for enrolment in a conservation contract. Parameters that under-estimate the true coordination benefits are less damaging to policy performance than those which over-estimate these benefits.
abstract_zh: 私人土地保护的经济激励设计正日益受到关注，以促进空间协调。我们通过一项以真实农民为参与者的框架实地实验，研究了在保护拍卖设计中采用关于空间协调生态效益的错误信息所产生的影响。研究发现，如果采用的参数“错误程度足够大”，以至于改变了保护合同优先纳入的农场排序，拍卖绩效可能会显著削弱。低估真实协调效益的参数对政策绩效的损害小于高估这些效益的参数。
title: Spatially coordinated conservation auctions under imperfect information about ecological spillovers
title_zh: 不完全信息下考虑生态溢出效应的空间协调保护拍卖

abstract: We analyse how agricultural extension services affect farm resilience using the Post-Russian Invasion Survey of Smallholder Farmers in Ukraine for 2022–3. Farm household resilience is measured using the Resilience Capacity Index (RCI), constructed from Adaptive Capacity (AC), Assets (AST), Social Safety Nets (SSN), and Sensitivity (S). To address the heterogeneity problem, Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) defines homogenous resilience profiles. The manuscript also examines a causal relationship by incorporating treatment effects into latent analysis. The results reveal that extension service receivers experience higher levels of AST and SSN. The extension service has a positive effect on RCI levels.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2022-2023年乌克兰小农户战后入侵调查数据，分析农业推广服务如何影响农场韧性。农场家庭韧性通过韧性能力指数（RCI）衡量，该指数由适应能力（AC）、资产（AST）、社会安全网（SSN）和敏感性（S）构成。为应对异质性问题，采用潜在剖面分析（LPA）定义同质韧性剖面。本文还通过将处理效应纳入潜在分析，考察因果关系。结果显示，接受推广服务的农户在AST和SSN方面水平更高。推广服务对RCI水平具有正向影响。
title: Agricultural extension services for farm resilience in Russian–Ukrainian Conflict
title_zh: 俄乌冲突背景下农业推广服务对农场韧性的作用

abstract: Despite an overwhelming scientific consensus about the adverse effects of climate change and potential adaptation strategies, the uptake rates of climate adaptation practices fall short of expectations and public perceptions about the drivers and implications of climate change remain mixed. This paper examines whether farmers’ psychological traits, particularly locus of control, predict climate adaptation strategies. We focus on adoption of drought-tolerant varieties, fast-maturing varieties, early/late planting varieties, crop diversification, conservation agriculture, and water harvesting technologies using a large household survey from Ethiopia. We also explore climate change perceptions, and whether and how they align with actual climatic records. We find that farmers with a higher degree of internal locus of control are more likely to adopt various climate adaptation practices and are more likely to perceive changes in mean precipitation and temperature, while those with a higher level of external locus of control are less likely to perceive climate change and hence less likely to adopt climate-resilient practices. One standard deviation increase in internal (external) locus of control is associated with 3–5 percentage points higher (lower) probability of adopting alternative climate adaptation practices. We also find suggestive evidence that farmers’ climate adaptation responses are consistent with their climate perceptions and actual climatic records. These findings highlight the important role of behavioral attributes, including psychological traits, in explaining climate perceptions and subsequent climate actions.
abstract_zh: 尽管科学界对气候变化的不利影响及潜在适应策略已形成压倒性共识，但气候适应实践的采纳率仍低于预期，且公众对气候变化的驱动因素及其影响的认识依然存在分歧。本文旨在探讨农民的心理特质，特别是控制点，是否能预测其气候适应策略。我们利用埃塞俄比亚的一项大规模农户调查，聚焦于抗旱品种、早熟品种、早播/晚播品种的采用，作物多样化、保护性农业及集水技术的采纳情况。同时，我们还考察了农民对气候变化的认知，以及这些认知是否及如何与实际气候记录相吻合。研究发现，内控倾向较强的农民更可能采纳多种气候适应实践，并更倾向于感知到平均降水量和温度的变化；而外控倾向较强的农民则较少感知到气候变化，因此采纳气候韧性实践的可能性较低。内控（外控）水平每增加一个标准差，采纳替代性气候适应实践的概率相应提高（降低）3至5个百分点。我们还发现了初步证据表明，农民的气候适应行为与其气候认知及实际气候记录相一致。这些发现强调了行为属性（包括心理特质）在解释气候认知及后续气候行动中的重要作用。
title: Locus of control, climate change adaptation and perception: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
title_zh: 控制点、气候变化适应与感知：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据

abstract: This paper considers equilibrium trade in a real estate market. When search is directed, buyers have private independent values, and sellers compete on asking prices, stock-flow matching characterises equilibrium outcomes. Consistent with the data, equilibrium not only generates large and variable price spikes for new listing sales; unsuccessful sellers lower their asking prices over time; and there is equilibrium asking price dispersion. Bidding war data demonstrate that the match surplus is substantial: a lower bound equals 3.3% of house price, whereas ballpark examples suggest match surplus is around 10%.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了房地产市场中的均衡交易。在定向搜索条件下，买方拥有私人独立价值，卖方在要价上竞争，存量-流量匹配刻画了均衡结果。与数据一致，均衡不仅导致新挂牌销售出现大幅且多变的房价飙升；未成功售出的卖方会随时间降低要价；且存在均衡要价离散现象。竞价战数据表明，匹配剩余相当可观：其下限相当于房价的3.3%，而粗略估算示例则显示匹配剩余约为10%。
title: Bidding wars in the housing market: When directed search becomes stock-flow matching
title_zh: 住房市场中的竞价战：当定向搜索变为存量-流量匹配时

abstract: Lithium, cobalt, nickel, copper, and rare earth elements are reshaping global trade and great-power politics in ways reminiscent of the earlier scramble for natural resources. This column argues that the familiar resource-curse mechanisms still bite, but do so in a rather difference context characterised by a supply chain that is bifurcated between scattered extraction and Chinese-concentrated refining, global demand that is exposed to rapid within-class technological substitution, and the absence of a multilateral architecture comparable to the one that disciplined the oil age. This creates genuine Knightian uncertainty and emphasises the importance of smart contract design, appropriate fiscal policy – particularly on taxation – and the governance of supply chains.
abstract_zh: 锂、钴、镍、铜及稀土元素正重塑全球贸易与大国外交格局，其态势令人回想起早期对自然资源的争夺。本文认为，熟悉的资源诅咒机制依然发挥作用，但其所处的背景已大不相同：供应链呈现分散开采与中国集中精炼的双轨结构，全球需求面临同类技术快速替代的冲击，且缺乏类似约束石油时代的多边治理架构。这构成了真正的奈特式不确定性，凸显了智能合约设计、恰当的财政政策（尤其是税收政策）以及供应链治理的重要性。
authors: Christopher Adam, Rabah Arezki, Frederick van der Ploeg

abstract: Discussions on Japan’s ‘lost decades’ have long focused on sluggish demand and the survival of ‘zombie’ firms. However, new evidence from microdata suggests a fundamental shift. This column argues that Japan’s productivity dynamics are moving from internal firm improvements to market-driven reallocation and reveals that the country’s unique ‘negative exit effect’ is largely driven by the mergers and acquisitions activity of high-productivity firms.
abstract_zh: 关于日本“失去的几十年”的讨论，长期以来聚焦于需求疲软和“僵尸”企业的存续。然而，来自微观数据的新证据表明，情况发生了根本性转变。本专栏认为，日本的生产率动态正从企业内部改进转向市场驱动的重新配置，并揭示该国独特的“负退出效应”在很大程度上是由高生产率企业的并购活动所驱动的。
authors: Kyoji Fukao, YoungGak Kim, Hyeog Ug Kwon
title: Japan’s productivity transformation: From within-firm stagnation to market-driven reallocation
title_zh: 日本生产率转型：从企业内部停滞到市场驱动的再配置

abstract: Does matching loan repayments to expected cash flows raise take-up and the welfare impact of microcredit? We test this in a randomized controlled trial with Morocco`s largest microfinance institution. The experiment introduces two new individual-liability loan products: a contract with a five-month principal grace period and a tailored contract with installments matched to expected revenues. Over 3,000 applicants are randomly assigned to an offer of one of the two new contracts or the standard loan. The new contracts attract distinct borrowers: agricultural households take up the grace-period loan, while entrepreneurs operating smaller, more capital-constrained businesses choose the tailored schedule. Most tailored-loan borrowers front-load their repayments, suggesting that demand for flexibility reflects cost minimization, not only liquidity management. The tailored loan raises sales and profits via non-agricultural business expansion and labor reallocation to self-employment. The grace-period loan shows similar but statistically insignificant effects. Neither product worsens repayment performance. We find no effects on investment or consumption. In a second stage, we randomize contract-specific information campaigns across 440 villages. Despite shifting stated preferences toward the advertised products, the campaigns do not raise take-up, consistent with supply-side frictions and a challenging macroeconomic environment.
abstract_zh: 将贷款还款与预期现金流相匹配是否能提高小额信贷的采纳率及其福利影响？我们通过与摩洛哥最大的小额信贷机构进行随机对照试验来检验这一问题。实验中引入了两种新的个人责任贷款产品：一种包含五个月本金宽限期的合同，以及一种还款计划与预期收入相匹配的定制合同。超过3000名申请者被随机分配至两种新合同之一或标准贷款的报价中。新合同吸引了不同类型的借款人：农业家庭选择宽限期贷款，而经营规模较小、资本受限企业的创业者则倾向于定制还款计划。大多数定制贷款借款者选择提前还款，这表明对灵活性的需求反映了成本最小化，而不仅仅是流动性管理。定制贷款通过非农业业务扩张和劳动力向自雇就业的重新配置，提高了销售额和利润。宽限期贷款显示出相似但统计上不显著的效果。两种产品均未恶化还款表现。我们未发现对投资或消费的影响。在第二阶段，我们在440个村庄中随机分配了针对特定合同的信息宣传活动。尽管这些活动将陈述偏好转向了广告宣传的产品，但并未提高采纳率，这与供给侧摩擦及充满挑战的宏观经济环境相一致。

title: Microcredit Made to Measure: Experimental Evidence from Rural Morocco

abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a ``market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备有助于中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任政策下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性降低冻结风险的作用。我们提出了一项“市场后盾原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则结合了状态依存的最后买家干预措施以恢复交易，并辅以适度的流动性要求以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。我们探讨了这对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的影响。
title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
title_zh: 储备与最后买家

abstract: We analyze the conflict of interest that arises when universal banks engage in proprietary trading of borrower stocks, which has been a prominent concern in the regulatory debates for a long time. We combine trade-by-trade supervisory data with credit registry information in Germany. Our findings reveal that lending relationships inform banks’ prop trading. To separate bank expertise and private information from lending as explanations, we study prop trading around corporate events. We show that banks execute purchases (sales) in borrower stocks in the weeks before positive (negative) news events, even when these events are unscheduled and surprising to the market. We link this trading pattern to situations when banks possess private borrower information, and rule out that it is explained by specialized expertise. We also find evidence consistent with information flows through banks’ centralized risk management, that banks alter trading patterns once they acquire private information, consistent with shrouding of informed trading, and that OTC counter-parties price-protect against relationship banks. Our evidence highlights the difficulty of avoiding conflicts in universal banking.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了全能银行在从事借款方股票自营交易时产生的利益冲突问题，这一直是监管讨论中的突出关切。我们将逐笔交易监管数据与德国信用登记信息相结合。研究结果显示，贷款关系为银行的自营交易提供了信息。为区分银行的专业知识与私人信息作为解释因素，我们围绕公司事件研究了自营交易行为。我们表明，在正面（负面）新闻事件发生前的数周内，银行会执行对借款方股票的买入（卖出）操作，即使这些事件是未安排的且对市场而言出乎意料。我们将这种交易模式与银行掌握借款方私人信息的情形联系起来，并排除了其由专业知识解释的可能性。我们还发现了与信息通过银行集中风险管理流动相一致的证据，即银行一旦获取私人信息便会改变交易模式，这与知情交易被掩盖的现象相符，并且场外交易对手方会对关系银行采取价格保护措施。我们的证据凸显了在全能银行中避免利益冲突的难度。
title: Conﬂicts of Interest in Banks: Evidence from Proprietary Trading
title_zh: 银行利益冲突：来自自营交易的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the role of resolvability as a new regulatory constraint for restricting bank behaviour. Using a regression-discontinuity design, we exploit the 2019 regulatory shock that made banks with assets below the $250 billion asset threshold exempt to mandatory resolution-planning (living will) requirements. We find that affected banks experience an increase in their profitability and their complexity. They also lend more and at more favorable terms. Credit granting is boosted especially in less resolvable loans with no covenant restrictions and in countries with poor creditor rights. Our findings suggest that by enforcing crisis plans, resolution requirements may contract credit supply.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了可处置性作为一项新的监管约束在限制银行行为中的作用。利用断点回归设计，我们借助2019年的监管冲击，该冲击使得资产低于2500亿美元门槛的银行免于强制性处置规划（生前遗嘱）要求。我们发现，受影响的银行盈利能力与复杂性有所提升，同时贷款发放增加且条件更为优惠。信贷投放尤其在不含契约限制、可处置性较低的贷款以及债权人权利保护较弱的国家中得到显著增强。我们的研究结果表明，通过强制实施危机计划，处置要求可能会收缩信贷供给。
title: Strong Wills, Strong Outcomes? Bank Resolvability and Credit Supply
title_zh: 坚强的意志，强劲的成效？银行可处置性与信贷供给

abstract: Do bettors misperceive expected returns, and does bringing their beliefs closer to the regulatory benchmark change betting and financial allocation decisions? Using a survey experiment in Brazil, we document that bettors are motivated by financial gain and entertainment and expect to receive approximately R$1.75 for every R$1 wagered, far above the R$0.85 regulatory benchmark. A randomized information treatment lowers bettors’ reported beliefs about expected returns by 28% to 37% but reduces the share of windfall income allocated to betting by only 2.1 percentage points. The treatment has a larger effect on the probability of allocating any money to betting than on the amount allocated among those who continue to bet. A parsimonious model rationalizes these findings: when betting provides substantial direct utility, more accurate beliefs have limited effects on betting expenditure and saving. Still, reducing overconfidence limits expected wealth losses, because overconfident bettors consume more today in anticipation of betting winnings that do not materialize on average. Information disclosure may therefore make beliefs more accurate without substantially reducing betting expenditure.
abstract_zh: 投注者是否误解了预期回报，而将他们的信念调整至更接近监管基准是否会改变其投注及财务分配决策？通过在巴西进行的一项调查实验，我们发现投注者既受财务收益也受娱乐动机驱动，他们预期每投注1雷亚尔能获得约1.75雷亚尔的回报，远高于0.85雷亚尔的监管基准。一项随机信息干预使投注者对预期回报的报告信念降低了28%至37%，但仅将意外之财收入中用于投注的比例减少了2.1个百分点。该干预对是否将任何资金用于投注的概率影响大于对继续投注者投注金额的影响。一个简约模型合理化了这些发现：当投注提供大量直接效用时，更准确的信念对投注支出和储蓄的影响有限。尽管如此，减少过度自信限制了预期财富损失，因为过度自信的投注者预期到平均而言不会实现的投注收益，从而在当前消费更多。因此，信息披露可能使信念更加准确，而不会大幅减少投注支出。
title: Overconfidence and Financial Behavior in Online Betting Markets
title_zh: 在线博彩市场中的过度自信与金融行为

abstract: Financial markets are highly differentiated: firms issue many products beyond stocks and bonds. This variety is consequential because the products firms use determine which issuers raise capital, on what terms, and which risks investors absorb. We propose a model of variety and firms’ allocation across products. Products repackage firms’ cash flows and differ in expected payoff per unit of exposure to aggregate risk and firm-specific risk passed to investors. Aggregate exposure raises the compensation all issuers must offer, whereas firm-specific risk lowers only the issuing firm’s payoff. We show that specialized products coexist with widely adopted ones through trade-offs between these two dimensions.
abstract_zh: 金融市场高度分化：企业发行的产品远不止股票和债券。这种多样性意义重大，因为企业所使用的产品决定了哪些发行者能筹集资本、以何种条件筹集，以及投资者承担哪些风险。我们提出了一个关于产品多样性及企业跨产品配置的模型。产品重新组合企业的现金流，并在传递给投资者的总体风险和企业特定风险的单位暴露预期回报上存在差异。总体暴露提高了所有发行者必须提供的补偿，而企业特定风险仅降低发行企业自身的回报。我们证明，专业化产品与广泛采用的产品通过这两个维度之间的权衡而共存。
title: Variety and Agglomeration in Financial Markets
title_zh: 金融市场的多样性与集聚

abstract: This paper examines the impact of exposure to high temperatures on the performance of downstream enterprises. By constructing “supplier-customer” pairs during 2010-2019, we explore exogenous variation in temperature and find that high temperatures in suppliers' regions significantly reduce the performance of downstream enterprises. The effects are more pronounced for non-state-owned, smaller, less digitalized, more supply-chain-concentrated, and less monopolistic enterprises. The possible channel is that upstream suppliers pass on the increased costs and risks due to high temperatures to downstream customers, leading to adverse impacts on their performance. Furthermore, downstream enterprises also conduct adaptive behaviors. This study enriches the research on the impact of extreme weather on business activities and provides insights for business managers on how to sustainably adapt to supply chain risks in a warming world.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了高温对下游企业的影响。通过构建2001—2022年间的“供应商—客户”配对，本文利用温度的外生变化发现，供应商所在地区的高温显著降低了客户的绩效。这一效应在非国有企业、规模较小、数字化程度较低、供应链集中度较高以及垄断程度较低的企业中更为明显。可能的传导渠道是，供应商将高温导致的成本增加转嫁给客户，从而对其绩效产生不利影响。本研究丰富了极端天气相关研究，并为在变暖世界中如何应对供应链风险提供了启示。关键词：极端高温 供应链风险 企业绩效 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G30

abstract: This article examines meat consumption behaviour across four meat categories (pork, beef, poultry and lamb) in urban and rural China through a dynamic demand system that accounts for habit formation and pre-committed effects. Based on provincial‑level data spanning the period 2015 to 2022, estimation results show that all categories are habitual, with beef being the most habitual and rural consumers displaying stronger habit formation. A higher level of pre-committed consumption is observed for pork relative to other categories, indicating that pork retains its position as a dietary staple among Chinese consumers, while pre-committed consumption for poultry is negative, reflecting its flexible and price-responsive role in household meat budgets. Demographic variables, including population growth and family size, are shown to significantly shape meat demand in urban areas, while ageing plays an important role in all four meat categories among rural consumers. Long-term elasticity prediction suggests that beef and poultry are likely to take a larger portion of future meat expenditure. Our findings provide empirical support for policymakers and industry stakeholders regarding future meat consumption, showing poultry can serve as a cost-effective substitute for pork and other red meats, while emphasizing the need to improve the supply chain resilience of beef production in China. abstract_zh: 本文通过一个考虑习惯形成和预先承诺效应的动态需求系统，考察了中国城镇和农村地区四类肉类（猪肉、牛肉、禽肉和羊肉）的消费行为。基于2015年至2022年的省级面板数据，估计结果显示所有肉类类别均具有习惯形成特征，其中牛肉的习惯形成最为显著，且农村消费者的习惯形成更强。与其它肉类类别相比，猪肉的预先承诺消费水平较高，表明猪肉在中国消费者饮食结构中仍保持主食地位，而禽肉的预先承诺消费为负值，反映出其在家庭肉类预算中具有灵活且价格敏感的作用。人口统计变量，包括人口增长和家庭规模，显著影响城镇地区的肉类需求，而老龄化对农村消费者所有四类肉类的需求均具有重要作用。长期弹性预测表明，牛肉和禽肉在未来肉类消费支出中所占比重可能更大。我们的研究结果为政策制定者和行业相关方提供了关于未来肉类消费的实证支持，表明禽肉可作为猪肉及其它红肉的经济有效替代品，同时强调提升中国牛肉生产供应链韧性的必要性。关键词：肉类消费 习惯形成 预先承诺效应 消费者行为 动态AIDS方法 JEL分类：Q11 Q18 D11 D12 Q10 致谢：感谢堪萨斯州立大学的Allen Featherstone、Edward Perry、Glynn Tonsor、Yangming Chang，亚利桑那州立大学的Justin Bina，肯塔基大学的Yuqing Zheng，佐治亚大学的Chen Zhen，以及密歇根州立大学的Jaime Luke提供的宝贵反馈和指导。

abstract: This paper assesses differences in countries' macroeconomic exposure to trade fragmentation along geopolitical lines. Estimating structural gravity regressions for sector‐level bilateral trade flows between 185 countries, we find that closer geopolitical ties are associated with lower barriers to trade, with the largest effects concentrated in a few sectors (notably, food and high‐end manufacturing). Consequently, countries' exposure via trade to geopolitical shifts varies with their market size, comparative advantage and foreign policy alignments. Introducing our estimates into a dynamic many‐country, many‐sector quantitative trade model, we show that geoeconomic fragmentation—modelled as an increased sensitivity of trade costs to geopolitics and greater geopolitical polarization—generally leads to lower trade and incomes. However, emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs) tend to see the largest impacts: real per‐capita income losses for the median EMDE in Asia are 80% larger, and 120% larger for the median EMDE in Africa, than for the median advanced economy. This suggests that the costs of trade fragmentation could fall disproportionally on countries that can afford it the least.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了各国在宏观经济层面对地缘政治贸易碎片化的暴露程度差异。通过估计涵盖185个国家部门级双边贸易流量的结构引力回归模型，我们发现更紧密的地缘政治联系与更低的贸易壁垒相关联，且最大效应集中在少数几个部门（尤其是食品和高科技制造业）。因此，各国通过贸易对地缘政治变动的暴露程度因其市场规模、比较优势及外交政策取向而异。将我们的估计引入一个动态的多国、多部门量化贸易模型后，我们表明，地缘经济碎片化——建模为贸易成本对地缘政治敏感性的增强及地缘政治极化程度的加深——通常会导致贸易和收入下降。然而，新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）往往受到最大影响：亚洲EMDEs中位数的实际人均收入损失比发达经济体中位数高出80%，非洲EMDEs中位数则高出120%。这表明，贸易碎片化的成本可能不成比例地落在最无力承担的国家身上。
title: Divided we fall: Differential exposure to geopolitical fragmentation in trade
title_zh: 分裂即衰：贸易中地缘政治碎片化的差异化暴露

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between economic conditions and incarceration in the postbellum United States. Leveraging unique administrative prison records in Missouri from 1850 to 1931 and the differential exposure to national agricultural price changes across counties, I find that positive economic shocks reduce prison admission rates for all crime categories, and negative shocks increase prison admission rates, with the relationship being larger for negative shocks. Although racial disparities in incarceration emerged after Reconstruction, with Black prison admission rates five times higher than white rates, I find no evidence that economic conditions affected prison admission rates differently across racial groups.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国内战后期经济状况与监禁之间的关系。利用密苏里州1850年至1931年间独特的行政监狱记录，以及各县对全国农产品价格变动的不同暴露程度，我发现正向经济冲击降低了所有犯罪类别的入狱率，而负向经济冲击则提高了入狱率，且负向冲击的影响更大。尽管重建时期后监禁中的种族差异显现，黑人入狱率是白人的五倍，但我未发现经济状况对不同种族群体的入狱率有差异化影响的证据。
title: Economic Conditions and Incarceration in the United States: Evidence from Missouri, 1850–1930
title_zh: 美国经济状况与监禁：来自密苏里州1850—1930年的证据

abstract: This paper studies the role of global banks as a source of shocks to global liquidity. Shifts in global liquidity can drive cross-border flows, asset prices, and exchange rates, with implications for financial stability. While the existing literature emphasizes global banks as amplifiers of global shocks, I provide causal evidence that idiosyncratic leverage shocks to these institutions loosen global liquidity conditions. The analysis exploits the high concentration of global banking to construct a Granular Instrumental Variable from the size-weighted sum of bank-level idiosyncratic leverage shocks. These shocks are estimated using Instrumented Principal Component Analysis, using observable bank characteristics (e.g., size, profitability, liquidity, and risk metrics) as instruments to account for bank-specific and time-varying exposures to common global factors. Using the instrument and panel local projections, I estimate the dynamic causal effects of these banks’ leverage shocks on key global liquidity measures for an unbalanced panel of 74 advanced and emerging market economies from 2000Q1 to 2022Q4. Positive shocks to global banks’ leverage significantly appreciate exchange rates against the dollar, reduce US dollar-denominated bond spreads, and increase gross cross-border inflows. Significant effects on total cross-border flows indicate broader spillovers across asset markets. These findings underscore the systemic relevance of G-SIBs in driving global financial conditions and support macro-financial models where financial intermediaries’ leverage is a key state variable influencing risk-taking and asset prices. By showing that global banks can originate, rather than merely transmit, global shocks, this paper adds to the literature on the global financial cycle and the international transmission of financial conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了全球银行作为全球流动性冲击来源的作用。全球流动性的变化能够驱动跨境资本流动、资产价格及汇率变动，并对金融稳定产生影响。尽管现有文献强调全球银行是放大全球冲击的渠道，本文提供了因果证据，表明这些机构特有的杠杆冲击会放宽全球流动性条件。分析利用全球银行业的高度集中性，通过银行层面特有杠杆冲击的规模加权总和构建了一个粒度工具变量。这些冲击采用工具变量主成分分析法进行估计，利用可观测的银行特征（如规模、盈利能力、流动性和风险指标）作为工具，以考虑银行特定及随时间变化的对共同全球因素的暴露。结合该工具与面板局部投影法，本文估算了2000年第一季度至2022年第四季度期间，74个发达经济体和新兴市场经济体组成的不平衡面板中，这些银行杠杆冲击对关键全球流动性指标的动态因果效应。全球银行杠杆的正向冲击显著使汇率对美元升值，降低美元计价债券利差，并增加总跨境流入。对总跨境流动的显著影响表明，冲击在资产市场间存在更广泛的溢出效应。这些发现强调了全球系统重要性银行在驱动全球金融状况中的系统性重要性，并支持金融中介杠杆作为影响风险承担和资产价格的关键状态变量的宏观金融模型。通过证明全球银行能够引发而非仅仅传导全球冲击，本文为全球金融周期及金融状况国际传导的相关文献做出了贡献。

abstract: We study how wars and military threats affect financial markets. Leveraging more than 300,000 monthly price observations since 1822, we create an external currency bond index for more than 90 countries - the EXBI. Using the EXBI, we document large effects of wars on returns and borrowing costs. In a global external bond portfolio, a one-standard-deviation war shock lowers returns by five percentage points. At the country level, wars at home generate sharp losses and increase default risk. Military threats depress bond prices in threatened states, but not in threatening ones, highlighting their role as a channel for eoeconomic coercion.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨战争与军事威胁如何影响金融市场。利用自1822年以来超过30万个月度价格观测数据，我们构建了一个覆盖90多个国家的外部货币债券指数——EXBI。借助EXBI，我们记录了战争对回报率和借贷成本的显著影响。在全球外部债券组合中，一个标准差战争冲击会使回报率下降五个百分点。在国家层面，本土战争导致剧烈损失并增加违约风险。军事威胁压低受威胁国家的债券价格，但对威胁发起国无此影响，凸显了其作为经济胁迫渠道的作用。
title: Wars, threats, and the sovereign bond market
title_zh: 战争、威胁与主权债券市场

abstract: This paper studies whether countries with larger foreign exchange and gold reserve buffers exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses to US monetary policy surprises. We test a central-bank reserve balance-sheet channel in which large reserve stocks can deter speculative pressure by signaling credible dollar-liquidity capacity, collateral value, and future intervention capacity, even without contemporaneous reserve sales. For identification, we use high-frequency FOMC monetary surprises, minute-level exchange rates, and predetermined reserve holdings for 18 countries. Countries with larger dollar reserves exhibit smaller exchange-rate depreciations after US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not display the same pattern. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller depreciations. These buffer effects are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines and are strongest where dollar exposure, especially external dollar liabilities, is larger. The results show that reserve composition and access to dollar liquidity facilities, not only aggregate reserve size, are empirically relevant for exchange-rate resilience.
abstract_zh: 本文研究外汇与黄金储备缓冲规模较大的国家，其汇率对美国货币政策意外变动的反应是否较小。我们检验了一个央行储备资产负债表渠道，即大规模储备存量可通过传递可信的美元流动性能力、抵押品价值及未来干预能力来抑制投机压力，即便当期并未动用储备进行销售。为识别因果效应，我们利用高频联邦公开市场委员会货币政策意外、分钟级汇率数据以及18个国家的预定储备持有量。美元储备较多的国家在美国货币政策收紧后汇率贬值幅度较小，而非美元储备则未呈现相同模式。黄金储备亦与较小幅度的贬值相关联。这些缓冲效应集中于未获得互换和回购额度的国家，且在美元敞口，尤其是外部美元负债较大的情况下最为显著。结果表明，储备构成及美元流动性便利的获取渠道，而非仅储备总量，对汇率韧性具有实证相关性。
title: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
title_zh: 地缘政治分裂时期的美国货币政策溢出效应、外汇与黄金储备

abstract: Theory suggests that corporate and sovereign bonds are fundamentally different, also because sovereign debt has no bankruptcy mechanism and is hard to enforce. We show empirically that the two assets are more similar than you think, at least when it comes to high-yield bonds over the past 20 years. We use rich new data to compare high-yield US corporate ("junkâ€ ) bonds to high-yield emerging market sovereign bonds 2002-2021. Investor experiences in these two asset classes were surprisingly aligned, with (i) similar average excess returns, (ii) similar average risk-return patterns (Sharpe ratios), (iii) similar default frequency, and (iv) comparable haircuts. A notable difference is that the average default duration is higher for sovereigns. Moreover, the two markets co-move differently with domestic and global factors. US "junkâ€ bond yields are more closely linked to US market conditions such as US stock returns, US stock price volatility (VIX), or US monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 理论认为，公司债券与主权债券存在根本差异，部分原因在于主权债务缺乏破产机制且难以执行。我们通过实证研究发现，这两种资产实际上比人们想象的更为相似，至少在过去20年的高收益债券领域如此。我们利用丰富的新数据，对2002年至2021年间美国高收益公司债券（即“垃圾”债券）与新兴市场高收益主权债券进行了比较。投资者在这两类资产中的体验惊人地一致，表现为：（一）相似的平均超额回报率，（二）相似的平均风险-回报特征（夏普比率），（三）相似的违约频率，以及（四）可比的减记幅度。一个显著差异在于，主权债券的平均违约持续时间更长。此外，这两个市场与国内及全球因素的联动性不同。美国“垃圾”债券收益率与美国市场状况，如美国股票回报率、美国股市波动率（VIX）或美国货币政策，关联更为紧密。
title: Sovereign vs. Corporate Debt and Default: More Similar Than You Think
title_zh: 主权债务与企业债务及违约：相似性远超想象

abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）历来易受外部冲击影响。近期，全球经济经历了数次重大冲击，然而新兴市场经济体表现出显著的韧性。这种表现的改善部分可归因于审慎的政策和更为坚实的经济基本面，但现有文献指出，一些基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体存在表现超预期的谜团。我们基于资本流动的自然水平（KF*）概念，评估了一种替代性的脆弱性衡量指标。具体而言，我们假设，在大型全球冲击发生前，若资本流动——具体指证券投资流入——超过KF*，则新兴市场经济体更为脆弱。结果表明，在过去二十年的重大全球冲击中，冲击前实际证券投资与KF*之间的缺口，对新兴市场经济体冲击后的表现具有显著的预测能力。
title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
title_zh: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性

abstract: The period after the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) was characterized by a considerable risk migration within global liquidity flows, away from cross-border bank lending towards international bond issuance. We show that the post-GFC shifts in the risk sensitivities of global liquidity flows are related to the tightness of the balance sheet (capital and leverage) constraints faced by international (bank and non-bank) lenders and to the migration of borrowers across funding sources. We document that the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows is higher when funding is provided by financial intermediaries that are facing greater balance sheet constraints. We also provide evidence that the post-GFC migration of borrowers from cross-border loans to international debt securities was associated with a decline in the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows to EME borrowers.
abstract_zh: 全球金融危机（GFC）之后的时期，全球流动性流动中出现了显著的风险迁移，从跨境银行贷款转向国际债券发行。我们表明，后金融危机时期全球流动性流动风险敏感性的变化，与国际（银行和非银行）贷款机构面临的资产负债表（资本和杠杆）约束的紧密度以及借款人在不同融资来源之间的迁移有关。我们记录了当资金由面临更大资产负债表约束的金融中介提供时，全球流动性流动的风险敏感性更高。我们还提供了证据表明，后金融危机时期借款人从跨境贷款向国际债务证券的迁移，与全球流动性流动对新兴市场经济体（EME）借款人风险敏感性的下降相关联。
