title: The Risk Sensitivity of Global Liquidity Flows: Heterogeneity, Evolution and Drivers
title_zh: 全球流动性流动的风险敏感性：异质性、演变与驱动因素

abstract: We present a new global index indicating how fixed are the world's exchange rates. Our index measures the probability of two units of GDP, randomly selected anywhere in the world, of being involved in a fixed exchange rate arrangement. This approach is invariant to alternative classifications of the Eurozone and is able to account for both direct and indirect exchange rate linkages between countries. In contrast to the "New Consensusâ€ view, which posits a continuity in exchange rate arrangements from the Bretton Woods era to the present, our index restores the conventional account of international monetary history over the last 70 years. Our findings indicate that global exchange rate fixity is now nearly three times smaller than prior to the 1971 Nixon shock, when major anchor currencies were pegged to each other. Furthermore, our measure partially puts into perspective the view that dollar dominance is now stronger than ever: we find that global anchoring to the US dollar was significantly more prevalent during Bretton Woods, particularly when accounting for indirect links.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个新的全球指数，用以衡量世界汇率固定程度。该指数衡量的是全球随机选取的两个GDP单位，其处于固定汇率安排下的概率。此方法不受欧元区不同分类方式的影响，并能同时考虑国家间直接与间接的汇率联系。与“新共识”观点相反——该观点认为自布雷顿森林体系时期至今，汇率安排具有连续性——我们的指数重塑了过去70年国际货币历史的传统叙述。研究结果显示，当前全球汇率固定程度几乎比1971年尼克松冲击前（当时主要锚定货币相互挂钩）低三倍。此外，我们的衡量标准在一定程度上对“美元主导地位空前强化”的观点提出了修正：我们发现，在布雷顿森林体系时期，全球对美元的锚定程度显著更高，尤其是在考虑间接联系时。
title: How Fixed are Global Exchange Rates?
title_zh: 全球汇率究竟有多固定？

abstract: The Global Macro Database is an open-source, continuously updated dataset of macroeconomic statistics that unifies and extends existing resources. By harmonizing and integrating data from 32 major contemporary sources-including the IMF, World Bank, and OECD-with historical records from 78 additional datasets, we construct comprehensive annual time series for 46 variables across 243 countries. This database covers global macroeconomic trends from the origins of modern data collection to projected estimates for 2030. Using this extensive database, we study the long-run output losses of financial crises and global temperature shocks, two applications in which historical time series are a crucial input. Our findings show that financial crises are associated with statistically detectable contractions in real GDP for five decades into the future, which are considerably larger than previously estimated. Temperature shocks also predict real GDP contractions up to 30 years ahead, especially in emerging economies.
abstract_zh: 全球宏观数据库是一个开源、持续更新的宏观经济统计数据集，旨在统一并扩展现有资源。通过整合来自国际货币基金组织、世界银行和经合组织等32个主要当代来源的数据，并结合78个额外数据集的历史记录，我们构建了覆盖243个国家、46个变量的全面年度时间序列。该数据库涵盖了从现代数据收集起源至2030年预测估计的全球宏观经济趋势。利用这一广泛数据库，我们研究了金融危机和全球温度冲击的长期产出损失，这两个应用场景中历史时间序列是关键输入。我们的研究结果显示，金融危机与未来五十年内实际GDP的统计显著收缩相关联，且这些收缩幅度远超先前估计。温度冲击同样预示着未来长达三十年的实际GDP收缩，尤其是在新兴经济体中表现更为明显。
title: The Global Macro Database: A New International Macroeconomic Dataset
title_zh: 全球宏观数据库：一个新的国际宏观经济数据集

abstract: We empirically examine the role of both official monetary policy announcements and policymakers' speeches in the transmission of monetary policy to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using intraday data covering a broad cross-section of financial assets, we construct the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual participants' bid and ask submissions. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases based solely on scheduled rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, speeches by euro area policymakers exert statistically and economically significant effects on asset prices across maturities, with magnitudes comparable to those observed following official policy announcements. Second, the transmission of speech-induced short-rate changes to the real economy closely mirrors that of policy decisions and combining both types of surprises significantly enhances the precision of statistical inference. Finally, when speeches are included in the measurement of policy surprises, the share of real-economy variance attributable to monetary policy increases fivefold, although its absolute magnitude remains relatively modest.
abstract_zh: 我们实证考察了官方货币政策公告与政策制定者演讲在欧元区货币政策向金融市场及实体经济传导中的作用。利用覆盖广泛金融资产的日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别政策事件的范围相较于仅基于预定利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，欧元区政策制定者的演讲对各期限资产价格产生了统计上和经济上显著的影响，其幅度与官方政策公告后观察到的效应相当。其次，演讲引发的短期利率变化向实体经济的传导与政策决策的传导路径高度相似，且将两类冲击结合使用能显著提升统计推断的精确度。最后，当演讲被纳入政策冲击的衡量时，货币政策可解释的实体经济方差份额增加了五倍，尽管其绝对规模仍相对有限。
title: Monetary Transmission with Frequent Policy Events
title_zh: 频繁政策事件下的货币传导

abstract: On February 24, 2022, as Russia invaded, the National Bank of Ukraine switched from a flexible to a fixed exchange rate regime. Was this policy response optimal? To answer this, we develop an open-economy model with both nominal rigidities and frictions in borrowing on international financial markets. We find that the carefully calibrated model can rationalize the NBU's decision: the optimal response to small shocks is to allow exchange rate flexibility, whereas in response to large shocks-such as an invasion-currency depreciation is suboptimal. For robustness, we consider tradable endowment, risk-premium, and non-tradable supply shocks, and add subsistence consumption.
abstract_zh: 2022年2月24日，随着俄罗斯入侵，乌克兰国家银行将汇率制度从浮动制转为固定制。这一政策应对是否最优？为回答此问题，我们构建了一个包含名义刚性和国际金融市场借款摩擦的开放经济模型。我们发现，经过仔细校准的模型能够合理解释乌克兰国家银行的决策：对小型冲击的最优应对是允许汇率浮动，而对大型冲击（如入侵）而言，货币贬值则非最优。为增强稳健性，我们考虑了可贸易禀赋冲击、风险溢价冲击和非贸易供给冲击，并引入了生存消费。
title: Foreign Exchange Regimes in (Normal Times and) Times of War: Insights from Ukraine
title_zh: （正常时期与）战争时期的外汇制度：来自乌克兰的启示

abstract: Why do so many eligible individuals fail to sign up for government social assistance benefits? While non-take-up of social benefits is of great concern both for the effectiveness and equity of social policies, academics and policymakers continue to be puzzled by the lack of clarity on why people forgo increases in disposable income. Focusing on literature from the Global South, this review puts forward an analytical framework that identifies how structural conditions shape the context in which individual and institutional factors operate. Together, these interact to mitigate or exacerbate compliance, learning, and psychological costs as well as perceived relative benefits. Findings are synthesised around the three cost types. Overall, this review concludes that individual characteristics alone rarely explain non-take-up as their effects are moderated by the structural, programmatic and institutional conditions in which they operate. This helps explain why the literature often produces inconclusive or even contradictory findings regarding the determinants of take-up. These findings prompt further investigation into the structural conditions and programmatic and institutional factors that shape take-up gaps, and that policies aiming to close these gaps should consider.
abstract_zh: 为什么如此多符合资格的个体未能申请政府社会救助福利？尽管社会救助福利的不领取现象对于社会政策的有效性和公平性都极为重要，但学者和政策制定者对于人们为何放弃可支配收入增加的原因仍感到困惑。本综述聚焦于全球南方的相关文献，提出了一个分析框架，用以识别结构性条件如何塑造个体和制度因素运作的背景。这些因素相互作用，共同缓解或加剧了合规成本、学习成本、心理成本以及感知的相对收益。研究结果围绕这三种成本类型进行综合。总体而言，本综述得出结论，个体特征单独很少能解释不领取现象，因为其影响受到其所处的结构性、方案性和制度性条件的调节。这有助于解释为何文献中关于领取决定因素的研究结果往往不具结论性，甚至相互矛盾。这些发现促使进一步研究塑造领取差距的结构性条件及方案性和制度性因素，并提示旨在缩小这些差距的政策应考虑这些因素。
title: Why do eligible individuals fail to enrol for social assistance programmes? A systematic narrative review of factors affecting take-up
title_zh: 为什么符合条件的个人未参加社会救助项目？关于影响领取率的因素的系统性叙述综述

abstract: Global conservation policies increasingly recognize the vital role of local and Indigenous communities in ecosystem protection, but mechanisms to support such communities’ livelihoods in a conservation context remain limited. Based on participatory engagement with diverse highland communities in the northern Thai tropics, we co-designed a highland origin label with the intention to alleviate Indigenous livelihood pressures. This study assessed whether this label can positively influence downstream urban consumers’ willingness-to-pay for Indigenous highland communities’ produce, using cross-sectional, qualitative, and choice experimental data. The study was implemented between February and April 2025 across four urban markets in Chiang Mai City, Thailand, including actual buying decisions for strawberries and chayote fruits and experimental exposure to background information on Indigenous highland livelihoods. The results from 888 real-market consumers revealed a substantial willingness-to-pay premium for origin-labelled products, with +11.6 Thai Baht/+56.3% on average (chayote: +10.4 Thai Baht/+50.0%; strawberries: +12.6 Thai Baht, +61.1%). Higher willingness-to-pay was positively associated with prior experience of purchasing labelled products and interest in Indigenous rights, negatively with price-conscious shoppers, and not associated with exposure to livelihood information. Large classes of shoppers (at least 75.9%) exhibited high utility for the origin label. Qualitative responses indicated strong positive sentiment and label credibility, although with a risk of overinterpretation. We conclude that co-developed origin labels can elicit substantial consumer willingness-to-pay, but translating it into tangible support for Indigenous livelihoods would require further considerations of agricultural value chain optimisation, cooperative support, channels for direct and consumer-segment-specific marketing, and tackling problematic Indigenous stereotypes.
abstract_zh: 全球保护政策日益认识到当地和原住民社区在生态系统保护中的关键作用，但在保护背景下支持这些社区生计的机制仍然有限。基于与泰国北部热带地区多个高地社区的参与式合作，我们共同设计了一个高地原产地标签，旨在缓解原住民生计压力。本研究利用横截面数据、定性数据和选择实验数据，评估该标签是否能积极影响下游城市消费者对原住民高地社区农产品的支付意愿。研究于2025年2月至4月在泰国清迈市的四个城市市场实施，包括对草莓和佛手瓜的实际购买决策，以及实验性接触原住民高地生计背景信息。来自888名真实市场消费者的结果显示，消费者对原产地标签产品具有显著的支付意愿溢价，平均溢价为+11.6泰铢/+56.3%（佛手瓜：+10.4泰铢/+50.0%；草莓：+12.6泰铢，+61.1%）。较高的支付意愿与先前购买标签产品的经验和原住民权利兴趣呈正相关，与价格敏感型购物者呈负相关，与生计信息接触无显著关联。大部分购物者群体（至少75.9%）对原产地标签表现出高效用。定性回应显示强烈的积极情感和标签可信度，但存在过度解读的风险。我们得出结论，共同开发的原产地标签能够引发显著的消费者支付意愿，但将其转化为对原住民生计的实际支持，需要进一步考虑农业价值链优化、合作社支持、直接和针对消费者细分市场的营销渠道，以及解决有问题的原住民刻板印象。
title: Heritage-sensitive interventions to support Indigenous peoples’ forest conservation: Evaluating an origin-label for highland produce in northern Thailand
title_zh: 支持土著人民森林保护的文化遗产敏感干预：评估泰国北部高地农产品的原产地标签

abstract: We estimate the short- and long-run impacts of a property tax reform in New York City (NYC) on the construction of new rental apartments. The reform, announced in 2006 and implemented in 2008, imposed new requirements to claim a property tax exemption. To estimate the short-run impacts, we use the delay between the announcement and the implementation of the reform to estimate the excess housing starts in response to a future property tax increase. We find that the tax reform induced excess building starts of 10,735 new rental units, equivalent to 1% of the 2007 rental housing stock. To estimate the long-run impacts, we use a difference-in-differences (DiD) strategy comparing census tracts in regions where the new requirements to obtain the tax exemption were stringent vs. tracts in regions where the new requirements were lenient. We find that the tracts with new strict requirements built 0.58 to 0.81 (22.25 to 22.75) more new buildings (new rental units) relative to the comparison group census tracts. These estimates represent 0.3x to 0.4x (2.4x to 2.5x) the median number of new buildings (rental units) per census tract per year in the 2003–15 sample period. Our findings yield two conclusions. First, a property tax reform can increase residential investment in the long run, even if a grace period produces a temporal boom and bust in construction. Second, local tax policy is a key determinant of housing supply in cities with high density and land scarcity.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了纽约市房产税改革对新建租赁公寓的短期与长期影响。该改革于2006年宣布，2008年实施，对申请房产税豁免提出了新要求。为估算短期影响，我们利用改革宣布与实施之间的延迟期，评估了因未来房产税增加而引发的超额住房开工量。研究发现，税收改革促使新增开工10，735套租赁住房单元，相当于2007年租赁住房存量的1%。为估算长期影响，我们采用双重差分策略，比较了获得税收豁免新要求严格与宽松地区的普查区。结果显示，新要求严格地区的普查区相对于对照组，多建设了0.58至0.81栋新建筑（或22.25至22.75套新租赁单元）。这些估计值相当于2003-2015年样本期间每个普查区每年新建建筑（租赁单元）中位数的0.3至0.4倍（2.4至2.5倍）。我们的发现得出两点结论：第一，即使宽限期导致建筑活动出现暂时繁荣与萧条，房产税改革仍能在长期内增加住宅投资；第二，在人口密集、土地稀缺的城市中，地方税收政策是住房供应的关键决定因素。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The impact of property tax incentives on residential investment
title_zh: 房产税激励对住宅投资的影响

abstract: This paper examines how corporate strategy uniqueness influences stock price crash risk. Using portfolio analyses and panel regressions, we find that firms pursuing more unique strategies exhibit significantly lower crash risk. Channel analyses suggest that strategically unique firms face lower competitive pressure and weaker incentives to withhold bad news, thereby mitigating crash risk. Cross-sectional results further indicate that this negative relationship is stronger among firms with greater information asymmetry and weaker corporate governance. Overall, our findings provide important evidence on the role of corporate strategy in shaping firms’ downside tail risk.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业战略独特性如何影响股价崩盘风险。通过组合分析与面板回归，我们发现采取更为独特战略的企业展现出显著更低的崩盘风险。渠道分析表明，战略独特的企业面临较低的竞争压力及较弱的隐瞒坏消息动机，从而缓解了崩盘风险。截面结果进一步指出，在信息不对称程度较高及公司治理较弱的企业中，这一负向关系更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究为理解企业战略在塑造公司下行尾部风险中的作用提供了重要证据。
title: Strategy uniqueness and stock price crash risk
title_zh: 策略独特性与股价崩盘风险

abstract: Motivated by the emergence of new official creditors outside the Paris Club framework, we study the interaction between senior official lending and market debt. We develop a quantitative sovereign default model featuring a large senior lender with whom borrowing terms are negotiated. Obtaining more net financing from the market strengthens the government’s bargaining position and improves bilateral terms. This endogenous cross-elasticity erodes the discipline of spreads and amplifies debt dilution, leading to welfare losses even as bilateral borrowing helps avert some defaults ex-post. With pre-specified rules, rewarding market issuance can be enough to generate such losses, and an optimal rule instead raises bilateral rates with net market financing. The direction of the cross-elasticity can thus guide in practice the assessment of new forms of bilateral sovereign debt.
abstract_zh: 受巴黎俱乐部框架之外新兴官方债权人出现的启发，我们研究了高级官方贷款与市场债务之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个定量主权违约模型，其中包含一个大型高级贷款人，其借款条款通过谈判确定。从市场获得更多净融资增强了政府的谈判地位，并改善了双边条款。这种内生交叉弹性削弱了利差的纪律性，并加剧了债务稀释，即使双边借款在事后有助于避免一些违约，也会导致福利损失。在预设规则下，奖励市场发行可能足以产生此类损失，而最优规则反而会随着市场净融资增加而提高双边利率。因此，交叉弹性的方向在实践中可指导对新形式双边主权债务的评估。
title: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt
title_zh: 双边主权债务的风险

abstract: When an individual's income changes, it can affect their entire household. We study the intrahousehold effects of an unconditional cash transfer in which 1,000 individuals were randomly selected to receive a $1,000 per month transfer for three years, while a control group of 2,000 participants received $50 per month over the same time period. We find no effects on aggregate measures of household stability, although there is suggestive evidence of improved relationship quality and greater trust in partners among recipients in relationships. Transfers to friends and family increase, consistent with recipients sharing some of the additional income with others. There are also spillovers on the income and employment-related outcomes of other household members: household income excluding the recipient decreases by about $1,700 per year, and partners are less likely to be promoted or to move to a better job. Other household members are significantly more likely to participate in education or training, and recipients are also more likely to report someone in their household having to forgo healthcare, potentially reflecting greater engagement with the healthcare system and the identification of previously unmet needs. We observe limited changes in decision-making power or division of labor within the household. Some indicators of intimate partner violence decline, particularly for women, but reported incidence is low and most estimates do not remain statistically significant after adjustment for multiple hypothesis testing. Subgroup differences are generally imprecise, although point estimates suggest larger education and health spillover effects when the recipient is a woman. Household structure also appears to mediates the impacts of the transfers.
abstract_zh: 当个人收入发生变化时，这可能影响其整个家庭。我们研究了一项无条件现金转移支付在家庭内部的影响，其中随机选取了1000名个体，每月接受1000美元的转移支付，为期三年，而对照组2000名参与者在同一时期内每月接受50美元。我们发现，在家庭稳定性的总体指标上没有显著影响，尽管有迹象表明，处于恋爱关系中的受助者报告的关系质量有所提升，对伴侣的信任度增强。对朋友和家人的转移支付增加，这与受助者与他人分享部分额外收入的行为一致。此外，对其他家庭成员的收入和就业相关结果产生了溢出效应：不包括受助者的家庭收入每年减少约1700美元，伴侣晋升或跳槽至更好工作的可能性降低。其他家庭成员参与教育或培训的可能性显著增加，同时受助者更可能报告家中有人不得不放弃医疗服务，这可能反映了对医疗系统更深的参与及对先前未满足需求的识别。我们观察到家庭内部决策权或劳动分工的变化有限。一些亲密伴侣暴力的指标有所下降，尤其是对女性而言，但报告的发生率较低，且多数估计值在多重假设检验调整后不再具有统计显著性。亚组差异通常不精确，尽管点估计表明，当受助者为女性时，教育和健康溢出效应更大。家庭结构似乎也调节了转移支付的影响。
title: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
title_zh: 收入冲击与家庭内部动态：来自保障收入实验的证据

abstract: We study how large language models write code for econometric analysis. We compare three dimensions of AI-assisted coding: statistical software (Stata, R, or Python), prompting (zero-shot versus few-shot), and the degree of agency, from a chatbot that writes a single script to an agent that executes and revises its own code. On a benchmark of applied econometric and statistical tasks, moving from the chatbot to the constrained agent raises task success from 74 to 96 percent, at about eight additional cents per run. For Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 through Codex, few-shot prompting improves the chatbot far more than the constrained agent, indicating that prompting and agency act as substitutes. For these models, differences across statistical software are sizeable under the chatbot but largely disappear under the constrained agent.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大型语言模型如何为计量经济学分析编写代码。我们比较了AI辅助编程的三个维度：统计软件（Stata、R或Python）、提示方式（零样本与少样本），以及代理程度，从生成单一脚本的聊天机器人到执行并修订自身代码的智能体。在一组应用计量经济学和统计任务的基准测试中，从聊天机器人转向受限智能体将任务成功率从74%提升至96%，每次运行成本仅增加约八美分。对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和通过Codex运行的GPT-5.4，少样本提示对聊天机器人的改进远大于受限智能体，表明提示与代理程度互为替代。对于这些模型，不同统计软件之间的差异在聊天机器人下显著，但在受限智能体下基本消失。
title: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
title_zh: AI代理与提示工程在计量经济学编程中的应用

abstract: Low property taxes amplify lock-in among elderly homeowners, limiting housing access for young families. Raising them reallocates housing toward the young through two channels: capitalization into lower prices reduces required downpayments for financially constrained buyers, a form of embedded leverage, while higher tax obligations raise holding costs for older owners. In our overlapping generations model, raising California’s property taxes to Texas levels increases young homeownership while decreasing elderly homeownership. Removing step-up basis also lowers elderly homeownership, suggesting their tenure is sustained by bequest tax advantages. The tax treatment of housing shapes housing allocation across generations.
abstract_zh: 低房产税加剧了老年房主的锁定效应，限制了年轻家庭的住房获取。提高房产税通过两条渠道将住房重新分配给年轻人：资本化导致房价下降，从而降低了受财务约束购房者的首付要求，这是一种嵌入式杠杆形式；同时，更高的税负增加了老年房主的持有成本。在我们的世代交叠模型中，将加利福尼亚州的房产税提高至得克萨斯州水平，会增加年轻群体的住房拥有率，同时降低老年群体的住房拥有率。取消递增基税基也会降低老年住房拥有率，表明其居住期限由遗产税优惠所维持。住房的税收处理方式塑造了跨代际的住房分配格局。
title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
title_zh: 财政约束下的房产税与住房配置

abstract: How should regulators combine staged access to a dual-use AI model with developer liability? I model a defender and an adversary searching for the same software flaws. After release, liability induces more defensive search but also makes the adversary search harder, limiting its effect on harm. Exclusive access removes this strategic response, so staged access and liability are complements in protection. Defensive effort rises towards the release date, making additional delay progressively less productive. Optimal evaluation windows are therefore bounded, and their response to greater harm saturates. Because defensive search uses real resources, the efficient liability rate can be below full internalisation of harm. That rate generally cannot induce the developer to choose the regulator's preferred release date, leaving a distinct role for a timing mandate.
abstract_zh: 监管者应如何将双用途AI模型的分阶段访问与开发者责任相结合？我构建了一个防御者与对手同时搜寻相同软件漏洞的模型。发布后，责任机制虽能激励更多防御性搜寻，但也会促使对手加大搜寻力度，从而削弱其对损害的限制作用。独占访问消除了这一策略性反应，因此分阶段访问与责任在防护上具有互补性。防御性努力随发布日期的临近而增加，使得额外延迟的生产力逐渐递减。因此，最优评估窗口是有界的，其对更大损害的反应趋于饱和。由于防御性搜寻消耗实际资源，有效责任率可低于损害的完全内部化水平。该比率通常无法诱导开发者选择监管者偏好的发布日期，这为时间指令留下了独特的作用空间。
title: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: 分阶段准入与双重用途人工智能的责任

abstract: This study examines the persistence of fertility-related health problems across generations within the same family, and the utilization of assisted reproductive technologies (ART). Using comprehensive Swedish registry data, we document significant intergenerational transmission of fertility difficulties for both daughters and sons, independent of parental socioeconomic status. Daughters whose parents reported such problems are 2.6 percentage points, or 19.4 percent, more likely to experience fertility problems themselves. Sons whose parents reported fertility difficulties experience a 1.7 percentage point, or 13.5 percent, increase. These associations persist across alternative measures and samples. Comparing biological and adopted children raised in the same households, we find that this phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by family awareness of fertility issues, pointing to biological and other factors that biological children share with their parents but adopted children do not. Medical technology works equally well for those who use it, and we find no significant association between the success of advanced fertility treatments and parental backgrounds. However, past generations’ fertility difficulties are associated both with higher medical expenses and with social costs such as increased likelihood of divorce.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了同一家族内生育健康问题在代际间的持续性，以及辅助生殖技术（ART）的利用情况。利用瑞典全面的登记数据，我们记录了生育困难在女儿和儿子中的显著代际传递现象，这一现象与父母的社会经济地位无关。父母报告有此类问题的女儿，其自身遭遇生育问题的可能性高出2.6个百分点，即19.4%；而父母报告有生育困难的儿子，其风险则增加1.7个百分点，即13.5%。这些关联在不同衡量指标和样本中均保持一致。通过比较在同一家庭环境中成长的亲生子女与收养子女，我们发现这一现象不太可能由家庭对生育问题的认知所驱动，而是指向了亲生子女与父母共享而收养子女不具备的生物学及其他因素。医疗技术对使用者的效果相当，我们未发现先进生育治疗的成功率与父母背景之间存在显著关联。然而，过去几代人的生育困难不仅与更高的医疗费用相关，还与离婚可能性增加等社会成本相关联。
title: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
title_zh: 不孕不育的循环：代际传递与辅助生殖的作用

abstract: Evidence that domestic outsourcing lowers pay comes largely from on-site transfers, in which workers move to a contractor but keep the same jobs. Displacement is rarely observed: whether workers lose their jobs, where they go, how earnings evolve. In Brazil’s 1993–1994 pro-outsourcing reforms, which differentially affected security guards, such transfers were rare; firms instead used occupational layoffs, shedding their guards while keeping other workers. Displaced guards’ employment recovered within five years, but many changed occupations and wages stayed about 12% lower. Lifetime losses average 1.2 to 1.5 years of pre-layoff earnings, concentrated among workers from high-wage firms, reflecting lost premia.
abstract_zh: 关于国内外包降低薪酬的证据，主要来源于现场转移案例，即工人转至承包商处工作但岗位不变。而工人失业、去向及收入变化等位移现象则鲜有观察。在巴西1993至1994年的促进外包改革中，该政策对保安人员产生了差异化影响，此类转移情况罕见；企业反而采取职业性裁员，解雇保安而保留其他员工。被裁保安的就业状况在五年内得以恢复，但许多人转换了职业，工资水平仍低约12%。终身损失平均相当于裁员前收入的1.2至1.5年，且集中于来自高工资企业的工人，反映了失去的溢价。
title: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
title_zh: 国内外包的替代效应

abstract: How should payers balance fiscal sustainability with access to transformative medical technology? We study Louisiana’s 2019 Medicaid subscription model for hepatitis C (HCV), the first example of a U.S. state employing a two-part tariff to secure unlimited access to curative medicines. Using a differences-in-differences design comparing spending on beneficiaries with HCV to those with diabetes or HIV, we find that treatment volume tripled, medical spending fell, and new HCV diagnoses declined 23 percent. The state’s $37 million in incremental spending on antivirals generated $266 million in five-year savings. Innovative financing models can generate health benefits and near-term savings for payers.
abstract_zh: 支付方应如何在财政可持续性与获取变革性医疗技术之间取得平衡？我们研究了路易斯安那州2019年针对丙型肝炎（HCV）的医疗补助订阅模式，这是美国首个采用两部定价法以确保无限制获取治愈性药物的州级案例。利用双重差分设计，将丙型肝炎受益人的支出与糖尿病或HIV患者进行比较，我们发现治疗量增加了两倍，医疗支出下降，新发丙型肝炎诊断减少了23%。该州在抗病毒药物上的3300万美元增量支出，在五年内产生了2.66亿美元的节省。创新融资模式能够为支付方带来健康收益和近期成本节约。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国路易斯安那州的医疗补助计划，数据、制度背景和核心应用均与美国相关，不涉及中国。
title: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
title_zh: 支出以拯救：路易斯安那州根除丙型肝炎的订阅模式

abstract: In this paper, we characterize trends in the earnings assimilation of immigrant workers from 1981 to 2021. We use administrative longitudinal data that contain the earnings of workers beginning in their first year of residence in the United States and in each year thereafter, allowing us to identify immigrants who eventually leave the United States (referred to here as return migrants). We use those data to produce the first examination of trends in earnings assimilation over a 41-year period and to estimate earnings assimilation separately for return migrants versus those who stay in the United States. We document several new facts about immigrants who arrived between 1981 to 2010. First, roughly one-fifth to one-third of immigrants return migrate from the United States within 10 years after arrival. Second, return migrants have entry earnings similar to those of permanent migrants but experience slower rates of earnings growth. Third, earnings assimilation occurs relatively quickly for cohorts arriving since the mid-1990s: The earnings of permanent immigrants converge, or come close to converging, with those of native-born people within 10 years after arrival. Migrants from earlier arrival cohorts experience significant earnings growth but generally do not converge to that of the native born. We discuss how changes in the labor market quality of immigrant cohorts (measured by their relative earnings upon entry) and selective return migration play an important role in determining whether repeated cross-sectional data over- or underestimate earnings assimilation.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了1981年至2021年间移民工人收入同化的趋势。我们利用行政纵向数据，这些数据记录了工人在美国居住第一年及之后每年的收入，从而能够识别最终离开美国的移民（此处称为回流移民）。借助这些数据，我们首次对长达41年间的收入同化趋势进行了考察，并分别估算了回流移民与留美移民的收入同化情况。我们记录了1981年至2010年间抵达美国的移民的几个新事实。第一，大约五分之一至三分之一的移民在抵达后10年内从美国回流。第二，回流移民的初始收入与永久移民相似，但其收入增长速度较慢。第三，自1990年代中期以来抵达的移民群体，其收入同化发生得相对较快：永久移民的收入在抵达后10年内与本土出生人群的收入趋同或接近趋同。而更早抵达的移民群体虽经历了显著的收入增长，但总体上并未与本土出生人群的收入趋同。我们讨论了移民群体劳动力市场质量的变化（以其入境时的相对收入衡量）以及选择性回流移民，在决定重复横截面数据是高估还是低估收入同化方面所起的重要作用。
title: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
title_zh: 移民收入同化，1981-2021年

abstract: We estimate the Phillips curve for India to shed light on the output-inflation tradeoff in developing economies. We develop a method to estimate the slope of the Phillips curve based on sufficient statistics that apply to a broad class of New Keynesian models. Using portable causal research designs, we estimate the firm-level passthrough of cost shocks into prices at different horizons, and the slope of marginal cost curves at different levels of aggregation. These empirical moments map into the slope of the Phillips curve and yield a decomposition into three terms: price rigidity, micro real rigidities, and macro real rigidities. The slope of the Phillips curve in India is one order of magnitude steeper than in the United States. This difference is explained by weaker macro real rigidities and less rigid prices. Extending the model to allow for input misallocation, we find that the re-allocative effects of monetary policy affect the Phillips curve, but this effect is small.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了印度的菲利普斯曲线，以揭示发展中经济体的产出-通胀权衡关系。我们开发了一种基于充分统计量的方法来估计菲利普斯曲线的斜率，该方法适用于广泛的新凯恩斯主义模型类别。利用便携式因果研究设计，我们估算了企业层面成本冲击在不同时间跨度上向价格的传导程度，以及不同聚合水平上边际成本曲线的斜率。这些经验矩映射到菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并分解为三个项：价格刚性、微观实际刚性和宏观实际刚性。印度的菲利普斯曲线斜率比美国陡峭一个数量级。这一差异归因于较弱的宏观实际刚性和较不刚性的价格。将模型扩展以允许投入错配，我们发现货币政策的再配置效应影响菲利普斯曲线，但这一效应较小。
title: How Steep is the Phillips Curve in Developing Economies? A Sufficient Statistics Approach and Estimates for India
title_zh: 发展中国家菲利普斯曲线有多陡峭？一个充分统计量方法及对印度的估计

abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
abstract_zh: 工作流动性具有风险，工人是风险规避的，且保险市场不完善。本文研究这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作间转换：他们过分重视工作安全性，而轻视工资和生产率收益。我们通过一项定制、具有代表性的调查，引出在职工人的工资-安全性无差异曲线，从而展示这一权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人要求每增加一个百分点的年度失业风险，需获得1.63%的加薪才愿意接受新工作。我们通过将该机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。工作不仅在工资（生产率）上存在差异，也在失业风险上有所不同，风险规避的工人通过非状态依赖债券进行自我保险，同时在职或离职状态下进行搜索。我们发现，一个完全市场的反事实情景将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受风险高但生产率高的职位，从而提高生产率（提高1.3%）和职位创造——同时也增加了失业和失业率。
title: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
title_zh: 谨慎的职业路径：不完全市场下的职业流动性

abstract: We identify a strong common risk factor structure that is pervasive across corporate securities: stocks, corporate bonds, and options. The common factors are closely linked to observable factors and key economic indicators. These factors explain much of the variation in individual asset returns, although pricing errors persist. A joint mean-variance efficient portfolio across asset classes achieves a high Sharpe ratio, resulting in part from cross-market hedging of the common sources of risk. We develop a measure of market segmentation based on differences in the common factor risk premia between markets and document a significant degree of segmentation.
abstract_zh: 我们识别出一种在企业证券中普遍存在的强共同风险因子结构：股票、公司债券和期权。这些共同因子与可观测因子及关键经济指标紧密相关。尽管定价误差持续存在，这些因子解释了个体资产收益的大部分变动。跨资产类别的联合均值-方差有效组合实现了较高的夏普比率，部分归因于对共同风险源的跨市场对冲。我们基于市场间共同因子风险溢价差异开发了一种市场分割度量，并记录了显著的分割程度。
title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks, Bonds (and Options), Redux
title_zh: 股票、债券（及期权）收益中的共同风险因素：重探

abstract: Do corporate bond investors earn compensation for bearing credit risk? We construct a new historical corporate bond database spanning 128 years to estimate a corporate bond counterpart to the equity risk premium. Combining hand-collected archival data with modern sources, we assemble a panel of over 100,000 bonds and 7 million observations. While recent samples suggest corporate bond excess returns largely reflect the term premium, our long sample reveals a sizable and statistically significant credit risk premium. Credit spreads predict future corporate bond returns and macroeconomic aggregates, though their ability to forecast business cycle fluctuations weakens when prewar data are included.
abstract_zh: 企业债券投资者是否因承担信用风险而获得补偿？我们构建了一个跨越128年的全新历史企业债券数据库，用以估算与股票风险溢价相对应的企业债券风险溢价。通过将手工收集的档案数据与现代数据源相结合，我们汇集了一个包含超过10万只债券、700万条观测值的面板数据集。尽管近期样本显示企业债券超额收益主要反映期限溢价，但我们的长期样本揭示了一个规模可观且统计显著的信用风险溢价。信用利差能够预测未来企业债券回报及宏观经济总量，尽管在纳入战前数据后，其预测商业周期波动的能力有所减弱。
title: Reconstructing a Century of U.S. Corporate Bonds: Credit Risk in Historical Perspective
title_zh: 重构美国公司债百年史：历史视角下的信用风险

abstract: In 2008, the aggregate market value of U.S.-listed firms was roughly one-third higher than that of European-listed firms. By 2023, it was more than 300% higher, a difference of $34 trillion. The valuation gap is broad-based, rather than concentrated among a few superstar firms, and is driven by differences in firm values, not in the number of listed firms. Across sectors, the gap is larger in R&D-intensive industries and in industries with high returns to scale. European firms’ size is strongly correlated with home-country GDP, whereas U.S. firms’ size is unrelated to home-state GDP. Smaller European firms also face a particularly large cost-of-capital gap and do not appear able to substitute debt for limited access to equity financing, including venture capital. Taken together, these facts suggest that financial and product-market frictions constrain European firms’ ability to scale.
abstract_zh: 2008年，美国上市公司的总市值比欧洲上市公司高出约三分之一。到2023年，这一差距扩大至超过300%，差额达34万亿美元。这一估值差距具有广泛性，并非集中于少数几家超级明星企业，且主要由企业价值差异驱动，而非上市公司数量差异所致。从行业来看，研发密集型行业及规模报酬较高的行业中，这一差距更为显著。欧洲企业的规模与其母国GDP密切相关，而美国企业的规模则与所在州的GDP无关。较小的欧洲企业还面临尤为巨大的资本成本差距，且似乎无法通过债务融资来弥补股权融资（包括风险投资）渠道受限的问题。综合这些事实表明，金融和产品市场摩擦制约了欧洲企业的扩张能力。
title: The Value Gap: Europe Cannot Scale
title_zh: 价值缺口：欧洲无法实现规模化

abstract: Parents’ and teachers’ expectations and aspirations are critical drivers of educational outcomes, yet what causally shapes these expectations remains unclear. In the present study, we address this question by deploying the random experiment of meiosis: namely, conditional on parental genotype, offspring genotype is random, allowing for the unconfounding of unique child characteristics from the more general family and household environment. Using the Wisconsin Longitudinal Study, we employ Mendelian imputation to estimate the direct genetic effects of 18 polygenic indices on college encouragement, net of parental genetic background. The genetic propensity for educational attainment and mathematical ability predict stronger expectations of college attendance, while smoking behavior predicts weaker expectations. Psychiatric traits show no effects after multiple-testing correction, indicating that responses are concentrated on cognitive and behavioral traits. Mediation analysis finds that prospectively measured teachers’ encouragement accounts for roughly a quarter of the genetic effects on educational attainment for cognitive traits, but not for psychiatric traits. Genetic effects on expectations are amplified among high-SES parents and first-born children. Thus, genetic influences on educational expectations are narrow in trait scope and uneven across families, with encouragement serving as one channel linking genetic differences to educational inequality.
abstract_zh: 父母和教师的期望与抱负是教育成果的关键驱动因素，然而，究竟是什么因果性地塑造了这些期望，目前尚不明确。在本研究中，我们通过运用减数分裂的随机实验来解决这一问题：即，在父母基因型给定的条件下，后代的基因型是随机的，从而能够将独特的儿童特征从更广泛的家庭和住户环境中分离出来，避免混淆。利用威斯康星纵向研究，我们采用孟德尔插补法，在控制父母遗传背景的情况下，估计了18个多基因指数对大学鼓励的直接遗传效应。教育成就和数学能力的遗传倾向预示着更强的大学入学期望，而吸烟行为则预示着较弱的期望。经过多重检验校正后，精神特质未显示出显著效应，表明反应集中在认知和行为特质上。中介分析发现，前瞻性测量的教师鼓励在认知特质上解释了教育成就遗传效应的大约四分之一，但对精神特质则无此作用。遗传对期望的影响在高社会经济地位父母和长子/长女中有所放大。因此，遗传对教育期望的影响在特质范围上较为狭窄，且在家庭间分布不均，鼓励作为连接遗传差异与教育不平等的一条渠道发挥作用。
title: Do Children's Genes Evoke Educational Expectations? Direct Genetic Effects on Parents' and Teachers' College Encouragement
title_zh: 儿童基因会唤起教育期望吗？基因对父母和教师大学鼓励的直接效应

abstract: Using a randomized survey experiment in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we study how observability and commonality shape responses to a €1,000 employer bonus. Making an idiosyncratic bonus observable to coworkers lowers the marginal propensity to consume by 3 percentage points. Conditional on observability, extending the bonus to all coworkers raises it by 6 percentage points. Under a social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of 0.16 and a multiplier of 1.2. Thus, consumption responses depend not only on resources but also on whether income shocks are private, public, or shared within a salient peer group.
abstract_zh: 利用意大利消费者预期调查中的随机调查实验，我们研究了可观察性与共同性如何影响对1000欧元雇主奖金的反应。将一项特定奖金向同事公开，会使边际消费倾向降低3个百分点。在可观察的条件下，将奖金扩展至所有同事，则使其提高6个百分点。在社会互动模型下，后一效应意味着社会互动参数为0.16，乘数为1.2。因此，消费反应不仅取决于资源，还取决于收入冲击是私人的、公共的，还是在显著同伴群体内共享的。
title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
title_zh: 消费中的可观测性与社会互动

abstract: We ask a representative sample to write prompts seeking spending and investing advice from LLMs, then simulate the lifetime effects of following the advice under realistic asset and labor market conditions. Applying this method to GPT-5.2, we find following the advice would move respondents toward life cycle theory: broader participation in diversified equity funds, age-declining equity shares, and larger savings buffers. Recommendations vary systematically by gender, prior AI experience, and financial literacy. For gender, two-thirds of recommended equity-share differences arise from men and women writing different prompts (demand), while one-third arise from gender labels attached to otherwise identical prompts (supply).
abstract_zh: 我们邀请了一个具有代表性的样本，撰写向大语言模型寻求支出与投资建议的提示词，然后在现实的资产与劳动力市场条件下，模拟遵循这些建议所产生的终身影响。将此方法应用于GPT-5.2，我们发现遵循其建议会使受访者更接近生命周期理论：更广泛地参与多元化股票基金、随年龄递减的股票配置比例，以及更大的储蓄缓冲。建议因性别、先前人工智能经验及金融素养的不同而呈现系统性差异。就性别而言，建议中股票配置差异的三分之二源于男性和女性撰写了不同的提示词（需求侧），而三分之一源于性别标签附着于原本相同的提示词（供给侧）。
title: AI Financial Advice: Supply, Demand, and Life Cycle Implications
title_zh: 人工智能金融咨询：供给、需求与生命周期影响

abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.
abstract_zh: 本文在综合评估框架下构建了平衡增长与最优气候政策的理论。尽管存在气候变化，平衡增长仍可实现，但增速放缓。由于排放会永久性提高碳存量，因此出现了两种截然不同的政策机制。在低损害情形下，最优增长与自由放任政策一致，碳定价保持恒定比率。在高损害情形下，最优政策通过设定温度增长上限以防止损失加剧，并以递增的碳定价实现比自由放任更快的经济增长。我们对模型进行了量化分析，表明经验损害估计跨越了这两种机制。在低损害下，最优政策实现1%的福利增益，每世纪升温3至8摄氏度，且长期增长不变。在高损害下，最优政策通过将升温限制在每世纪0.4摄氏度，使年增长率提高0.8个百分点，并实现26%的福利增益。
title: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
title_zh: 变暖世界中的增长平衡

abstract: We show that quantitative asset pricing models, built to address the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles, systematically fail when applied to open economies: they cannot generate the large and persistent interest rate differentials we observe between risky and safe currencies. This failure stems from the key mechanism that produces their success in matching both closed-economy puzzles: In these models, the mean of the stochastic discount factor offsets its variance nearly one-for-one, which immobilizes interest rates --- so that differences in expected currency returns across countries must arise almost exclusively from predictable changes in exchange rates, at odds with the data. We prove this result in a broad class of models that allows for market incompleteness and exchange rate disconnect, requiring only that each country's risk-free asset is priced by investors who demand compensation for risk in line with observed risk premia. We argue this tension between canonical asset pricing and international macroeconomic models is a key reason researchers have struggled to reconcile the observed behavior of exchange rates, interest rates, and capital flows across countries.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，旨在解决股权溢价和无风险利率之谜的定量资产定价模型，在应用于开放经济体时系统性地失效：它们无法生成我们在风险货币与安全货币之间观察到的巨大且持续的利率差异。这一失败源于使这些模型在匹配封闭经济体两大谜题时取得成功的关键机制：在这些模型中，随机贴现因子的均值几乎一对一地抵消其方差，从而固定了利率——因此，各国之间预期货币回报的差异几乎必须完全来源于可预测的汇率变动，这与数据不符。我们在一个广泛的模型类别中证明了这一结果，该类别允许市场不完全性和汇率脱钩，仅要求每个国家的无风险资产由那些要求风险补偿与观察到的风险溢价相一致的投资者定价。我们认为，经典资产定价与国际宏观经济模型之间的这种张力，是研究者们难以调和各国汇率、利率和资本流动观察行为的关键原因。
title: A Currency Premium Puzzle
title_zh: 货币溢价之谜

abstract: Union growth has historically happened in spurts. We combine union election data from 1961–2025 with a large-scale information experiment involving 9,000 low-wage workers to study the role of social learning in union growth. Observationally, close election wins cause future wins within state-industries. Experimentally, information about recent union wins increases union support and beliefs about co-worker support, with effects concentrated among workers with weak information environments and low baseline coworker support. In contrast, information about labor market tightness has little effect. Our results highlight social learning as a mechanism for union growth.
abstract_zh: 工会增长在历史上呈现间歇性爆发。我们结合1961年至2025年的工会选举数据，以及一项涉及9000名低工资工人的大规模信息实验，研究社会学习在工会增长中的作用。从观察上看，接近的选举胜利会导致州行业内未来的胜利。实验上，关于近期工会胜利的信息增加了工会支持度及对同事支持的信念，其效应集中在信息环境薄弱和同事支持基线较低的工人中。相比之下，关于劳动力市场紧张的信息影响甚微。我们的结果凸显了社会学习作为工会增长的一种机制。
title: Winning is Contagious: Social Learning and the Dynamics of Union Support
title_zh: 胜利具有传染性：社会学习与工会支持动态

abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases -- such as clustered exposure-- and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在估计溢出效应时实验的最优设计与分析。假设暴露映射已知（例如线性），我们刻画了处理分配分布及基于回归的估计量，这些能在广泛的不可观测变量分布类别中最小化最坏情况下的渐近方差。设计问题给出了一个直观的解决方案，其中规划者在溢出信号强度与溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题则产生了一个简单的重新中心化工具变量估计量，以最佳利用这种变异。该框架在几个基准情形下——如聚类暴露——提供了自然解决方案，并为一般网络（包括二分设置）提出了计算上可行的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学的两个应用在半合成实验中展示了这些新工具。我们的方法在两个实验中均大幅降低了标准误，使有效样本量增加了50%至100%或更多。
title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
title_zh: 溢出实验中稳健信号最大化

abstract: We trace the family origins of Members of Congress (MC) born between 1830 and 1950, linking each MC, their parents, and their brothers to the complete-count censuses. Future MCs have always been economic outliers. By 1940, close to 60 percent of MCs aged 18--40 held a college degree, against under 5 percent of comparable young men outside Congress. In the 19th-century censuses, MCs as adults held roughly three times the wealth of demographically matched controls. They also come from economically elite families: their fathers earn more, attain more education, and hold more wealth. The brothers of future MCs sit between the population and the MCs themselves. Across the socioeconomic measures we compare, we calculate that roughly half of an MC's adult premium is shared with his brother and the other half is his own. Even as the American economy and political system have changed, the family background gap has widened over the last century and a half. Wealth, household servants, and four separate occupation-based scores all show the gap holding or growing across cohorts. We study four Progressive-Era reforms in a triple-difference design---women's suffrage, the secret ballot, direct primaries, and the direct election of senators---and none produce detectable shifts in who reaches Congress. Our results document a Congress drawn from the most fortunate families in American society in every cohort we observe.
abstract_zh: 我们追溯了1830年至1950年间出生的国会议员（MC）的家庭出身，将每位议员、其父母及兄弟与完整人口普查数据相链接。未来的国会议员历来都是经济上的异类。到1940年，18至40岁的国会议员中近60%拥有大学学位，而国会外同龄年轻男性中这一比例不足5%。在19世纪的人口普查中，作为成年人的国会议员所拥有的财富约为人口统计特征匹配对照组的三倍。他们也出身于经济精英家庭：其父亲收入更高、受教育程度更高、财富更多。未来国会议员的兄弟们则介于普通民众与议员本人之间。在我们比较的各项社会经济指标中，我们估算出议员成年期优势中约有一半与其兄弟共享，另一半则为其个人独有。即便美国经济和政治体制不断变迁，家庭背景差距在过去一个半世纪中仍在扩大。财富、家中仆役数量以及四种基于职业的评分均显示，这一差距在各代际间保持或扩大。我们采用三重差分设计研究了进步时代四项改革——妇女选举权、无记名投票、直接初选和参议员直接选举——均未对进入国会的人员构成产生可检测的变化。我们的研究结果表明，在我们观察的每一代人中，国会成员均来自美国社会中最幸运的家庭。
title: Fortunate Sons: Elite Political Selection in American History
title_zh: 幸运之子：美国历史上的精英政治选拔

abstract: If frontier AI models can be used to develop their next models, this may lead to an ‘intelligence explosion’ and give a large boost to technological advancement. This column develops a framework for understanding how AI may transform the economy through new feedback loops. It shows that the potential for explosive growth depends on the labour share, the returns to research effort, and the share of automated tasks in each sector, and that the threshold may be surprisingly low. Bottlenecks in tasks that remain human, physical constraints on compute, and the pace of automation will shape whether these dynamics materialise.
abstract_zh: 如果前沿AI模型能够被用于开发其下一代模型，这可能导致“智能爆炸”，并极大地推动技术进步。本专栏构建了一个框架，用以理解AI如何通过新的反馈循环变革经济。研究表明，爆炸性增长的可能性取决于劳动份额、研究努力的回报以及各部门中自动化任务的占比，且这一门槛可能低得惊人。人类仍承担的任务中的瓶颈、计算能力的物理限制以及自动化的步伐，将决定这些动态是否会成为现实。
authors: Tom Davidson, Basil Halperin, Thomas Houlden, Anton Korinek
title: AI feedback loops and the conditions for explosive growth
title_zh: 人工智能反馈循环与爆炸性增长的条件

abstract: 金融科技是提升金融服务实体经济质效、支持企业“出海”的重要支撑。本文利用大语言模型识别中国商业银行金融科技专利,依托银行和企业的关系网络构造2013-2023年我国上市公司面临的银行金融科技创新水平,结合FactSet Revere全球供应链数据,考察银行金融科技创新对企业跨国供应链拓展的影响。研究发现,银行金融科技创新显著增加企业国际客户合同数量,促进国际客户网络拓展,但对国际供应商网络的作用相对有限,其主要推动了企业跨国供应链向下游延伸,且这种影响在非国有、中小规模、无通道业务,以及地区金融监管环境相对严格的企业中更为明显。银行金融科技创新通过信息识别、个性化信贷配置及风险承担机制,促进企业开展国际客户合作。本文从跨国供应链视角丰富了金融科技赋能实体经济和支持企业“出海”的经验证据。

abstract: 充分释放超大规模市场潜力,是推动经济高质量发展的重要议题。本文采用多时点双重差分模型,系统考察市场准入负面清单制度对居民消费的提振效应。研究发现：第一,该制度对居民家庭消费水平具有显著的提升作用。第二,在供给结构优化路径上,从企业层面看,政策实施后市场竞争加剧,同时企业创新投入有所增加;从行业层面看,企业进入主要集中在服务业,尤其是直接面向居民日常消费的生活性服务业;从家庭层面看,居民消费意愿增强,家庭储蓄率下降。在收入提振路径上,政策带动企业生产扩张和用工需求增加,居民工资性收入提升,消费能力随之增强。第三,异质性分析发现,市场准入负面清单制度的消费提振效应在制度环境较差、服务业发展滞后的地区更为显著。第四,政府干预规模过大会削弱政策效果,而增加一般公共服务支出能有效强化政策效果。本文为深化市场准入负面清单制度改革以促进消费扩容升级、强化供需双侧协同以及优化政府治理和财政支出结构提供了一定的经验参考。

abstract: 破除区域间行政分割是推动企业跨地区经营、实现区域市场整合的关键举措。本文基于全国税收调查与中国工商注册企业数据构建的“总部-分支”面板数据,使用多时点双重差分模型,考察以撤县设区为代表的行政区划调整对企业跨地区经营的影响。研究发现,撤县设区显著增加了总部位于被撤县的企业在本市辖区设立分支机构的数量,促进了商品与服务在市域内部跨地区流动。机制检验表明,该效应主要通过削弱区县间行政分割,进而降低制度性准入壁垒、增强市场可达性和优化金融资源配置实现。进一步研究发现,撤县设区对企业跨地区经营的促进作用主要表现为从外围到中心的单向“虹吸效应”,反向的“扩散效应”并不明显。本文为优化空间治理结构、破除区域间行政分割并推进全国统一大市场建设提供了微观证据。

abstract: “边缘企业”能否在既定出口市场持续扩张,是检验跨境电商政策赋能效应的重要维度。本文将跨境电商政策冲击引入多产品异质性企业框架,并基于2000-2015年中国海关数据库与上市公司数据的匹配样本,以2012年跨境电商政策推进为准自然实验,构建企业-出口目的地-年份层面的双重差分模型,考察跨境电商政策对企业在既定目的地市场出口突围的影响。研究发现,跨境电商显著促进了企业出口产品范围扩张和出口收入增长,且对初始出口能力相对较弱的“边缘企业”作用更强。机制检验表明,跨境电商通过缓解外部交易摩擦、提升目的地市场渗透效率和增强产品转换能力,从而缓解企业进入既定目的地市场后的扩张约束。此外,跨境电商赋能效应受国内供给侧调整能力、行业竞争结构以及海外本土化服务的共同制约。本文为完善数字贸易政策、稳定外贸主体及优化出口结构提供了经验证据。

abstract: 本文以生成式人工智能为研究对象,基于招聘平台岗位大数据,采用双重差分方法考察其对中国劳动力市场的影响。研究发现,生成式人工智能应用显著降低了岗位平均薪资。机制研究表明,现阶段其岗位替代效应大于生产率提升效应,是构成薪资下行的主要渠道。异质性分析发现,对软技能要求不高、认知型的岗位薪资下降更为明显;相比之下,依赖现场服务与人际交互的岗位薪资则有所上升。生成式人工智能在替代部分岗位的同时,亦带动了云网智能运维员、生成式人工智能系统应用员等新兴职业的岗位需求增长,体现出技术变革的创造性破坏特征。本文建议,应强化就业动态监测与完善多层次社会保障体系,积极培育新质生产力所需的职业类型,促进劳动力市场平稳转型。

abstract: 文化建设对于增强民众主观福祉有重要意义。本文基于网络外部性视角,利用中国家庭追踪调查与地级市博物馆数据,考察博物馆普惠化对居民幸福感的影响。研究发现,居民幸福感随博物馆供给扩大呈局部非连续跃增。当场馆数量较少时,布局较为分散,系统性福祉效应尚需网络支撑。随着供给持续扩大,当博物馆数量达到20家、服务半径达到居民可便捷抵达的合理区间时,居民幸福感显著提升。本文以“地级市博物馆数量首次达到20家”构造准自然实验,利用多期双重差分模型分析表明,博物馆普惠化使居民幸福感提升0.078个单位,主要通过增强公平感知、积累社会资本与改善心理健康三条路径实现。本文为优化文化基础设施布局、推动精神共富提供了经验依据。

abstract: Drawing on more than 89,000 firm-level observations from 94 countries across Europe, other advanced economies, Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East, sourced from the World Bank and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, we examine whether ambitious national climate commitments translate into greater corporate adoption of CO2 monitoring and energy management practices. The results show that an ambitious national net-zero target, defined as 2050 or earlier, compared with a later or no target, is associated with a statistically significant increase in corporate climate mitigation action once firm-level characteristics and country fixed effects are considered. When we focus on Western European countries with net-zero targets of 2050 or earlier, the positive effect is larger and remains statistically significant, especially for energy management practices. Firms with audited financial reports are the most likely to adopt these measures, while SMEs are the least likely. A regional disparity also emerges: firms in Eastern European countries outside the European Union (EU) that have experienced climate-related physical events with economic consequences are the most likely to adopt energy management measures. By contrast, firms in energy-intensive sectors in the same Eastern European countries, mainly industry and transport, are less likely than their EU peers to adopt these practices and show substantially lower probabilities of adopting climate measures.
abstract_zh: 基于世界银行与欧洲复兴开发银行提供的涵盖欧洲、其他发达经济体、非洲、亚洲、拉丁美洲及中东地区94个国家超过89,000个企业层面的观测数据，我们考察了国家层面的雄心勃勃的气候承诺是否转化为企业更广泛采纳二氧化碳监测与能源管理实践。结果显示，在考虑企业特征和国家固定效应后，与设定较晚或无净零目标的国家相比，设定2050年或更早净零目标的国家，其企业气候减缓行动显著增加。当我们聚焦于净零目标设定为2050年或更早的西欧国家时，这一积极效应更为显著，尤其是在能源管理实践方面。拥有经审计财务报告的企业最有可能采纳这些措施，而中小企业则最不可能。区域差异亦显现：在东欧非欧盟国家中，经历过具有经济后果的气候相关物理事件的企业最有可能采纳能源管理措施。相反，在同一东欧国家中，能源密集型行业（主要是工业和运输业）的企业，相较于欧盟同行，采纳这些实践的可能性较低，且采纳气候措施的概率显著更低。
